We can't stress this enough: For roughly the price of a bottle of soda, you can help cover the costs of registering a new voter.
We're already ramping up for November's midterm elections. RUSH $30 or more today and help us register a tidal wave of new voters nationwide >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-voterregistration?refcode=032426_2&amount=30]
Voter Action Project [https://voteractionproject.org/]
Our voter registration work never stopped, folks.
Despite vote-suppressing state legislatures making it harder to register to vote -- passing bills to stop organizations like ours and our partners on the ground from helping potential voters navigate the increasingly murky rules around voter registration -- we're still pulling out all the stops to bring voters into the system.
Voter registration is a critical part of grassroots efforts to protect voting rights. The more people who vote, the more our government looks like we, the people. But to get to the point where every voice is heard, we need your help .
Just $3 can help us register a new voter. Will you step up with $30 or more today to help register 10 new voters? >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-voterregistration?refcode=032426_2&amount=30]
If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:
GIVE $15 NOW ➜ [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-voterregistration?express_lane=true&refcode=032426_2&amount=15] GIVE $25 NOW ➜ [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-voterregistration?express_lane=true&refcode=032426_2&amount=25] GIVE $50 NOW ➜ [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-voterregistration?express_lane=true&refcode=032426_2&amount=50]

Voter participation has been increasing, and young people -- a major target of opponents of voting rights -- see the importance of voting now more than ever. Voting quickly becomes a habit -- a habit our democracy sorely needs to fulfill the promise of the American dream. Overwhelming key states with new voter registrations can help turn the tide against the voter suppression laws we've seen passed the last few years.
The midterm election will determine whether our democracy stays mired in the darkness and conspiracy theories we hear every day or if we can reclaim our rights -- from voting to choice and more -- and march forward to a better future.
New voter registration -- at just about $3 per new voter -- can be game-changing. Can you pitch in with $30 or whatever you can to help us register a wave of new voters ahead of voter registration deadlines? >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-voterregistration?refcode=032426_2&amount=30]
Thank you,
Voter Action Project's Registration Team

Integrity First Voter Action Project is dedicated to expanding ballot access and increasing voter participation across the country.
Since the Supreme Court gutted key provisions in the Voting Rights Act, extreme politicians have taken advantage to pass harsh laws that restrict access to the ballot box. These restrictions particularly affect disadvantaged communities and people of color. It’s our goal to bring awareness to these laws wherever they may crop up and organize voters to take action to ensure the right to vote is available to everyone in their states and communities.

name: Jill Biden
subject: Women’s History Month feels different this year
body:
---
Derek, This Women’s History Month, I am thinking of all the women who have blazed trails. Women who have climbed through the glass ceilings they shattered, and then held their hand out to lift up those who followed. This month, we honor the women who made us, the women fighting for a better world right now, and the women who will come after us. This year, though, Women’s History Month feels different. Different because, after decades of progress, our daughters have fewer rights than we had. Different because our freedoms are under attack by those who were elected to protect them. Derek, we cannot allow our progress to slip away. Every little girl must know that she belongs in all places of power, that her boldness is beautiful, that her body is her own, that her future can be anything she wants it to be. And every little boy must know that caring, collaboration, and kindness are signs of strength, not weakness, and that this is his fight, too. It is imperative that we elect leaders who reflect our values this November. We cannot allow those who are pulling away our hard-won progress to continue to run this country unchecked. The DNC is doing the work every day to elect Democrats who will fight for our rights and the rights of our daughters. The most impactful thing you can do right now to help is to make a contribution to the DNC today. [**So, if delivering a better future for our women and girls matters to you, could you please make a contribution to the DNC today? # [Fire FCC Chair for Violating the First Amendment](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tfb08444d-cb4b-496f-9537-566d35939c46/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

| | | The First Amendment protects our freedom of speech, at least until a guy like FCC Chair Brendan Carr sidles on up and takes a massive dump on it. Several, actually. Carr has been openly [threatening](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tc40d29d5-faaf-4040-add5-b722ee866607/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) entertainment and news figures who have the gall to criticize Trump, rather than kiss his supersized ass. You can't have freedom of speech if you get your livelihood taken away (or worse) for using it. And there is no way in hell you can have a guy who is openly hostile to freedom of speech in a position of such power over communications. [**Add your name, and demand that Carr be removed immediately. **](https://default.salsalabs.org/T3bf112aa-b76e-4173-b733-2671f21c45d2/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

name: John James
subject: I don’t tell this story often
disclaimer_text: Paid for by John James for MI, 35744 Van Dyke Avenue, Sterling Heights, MI 48312
body:
| | | Friend, It’s Republican John James, and I wanted to take a moment to share my story with you. It’s a story of the American Dream, Duty, Honor, and Service. My story starts on a street across from Mississippi State. My father lived there growing up but was unable to attend the school because he was Black. My parents grew up in the Jim Crow South, but that didn’t stop them from believing in the promise of America. They moved to Michigan, where my dad started our family business. He believed deeply in the American Dream and instilled in me a strong work ethic and the belief that I should never feel sorry for myself.
---
[](http://links.jjformichigan.com/u/click?_t=70fde66bc0554ca7a14c16f5ebafdbd9&_m=722bfe0fc1d5437fa65db2a2a0e0eed1&_e=q_0TKsUPTCqd_hpuJSZMIe1V2XUGhfM0_NTldmnViXceHiRpYWDzTnbp5qV8f3I_MEKARDi3PMzd0QID3cAt9nTt4c96yhA7O_SIFja56XottegsTxnSGw6ydv7UPQedjb2rBSxxYJaMIlX4u-P6oXNNYLg2L4HrbnEF2lu4KBeJDOrcPbNDE-jsAGqu3_7Aaz8Sk0QGt4uQZOvvLHZ4YaK-p2RJrvHo2uf-OU0c2bnSXblUeLnvy8styyd4LnNQKXgX4fdNwF38BaihAVguIJREEBEG-24GJIT0P6lIF7sxyunr7LcLonFoeWxnfhd4P40AwrUjmHmaMxNuoww3KyklQIu6tzH7i_FYDXaspgU9MC-WcNULLzwV_Jwu7p4Q2SfuK1jxCV8afFqcgLgYKpWfCEIKsIIdIkJMnJKILZ-qdEVtbKemaFgBgQf4_v3y)
---
Through my father’s and mother’s guidance, I learned the values that make America great. They taught me never to believe that I should receive handouts just because of the color of my skin. **_In America, we can be whoever we want to be._** That belief resonated with me more than anything else. I took my father’s teachings to heart. _That’s why, at the age of 18, I attended West Point._
---
[](http://links.jjformichigan.com/u/click?_t=70fde66bc0554ca7a14c16f5ebafdbd9&_m=722bfe0fc1d5437fa65db2a2a0e0eed1&_e=q_0TKsUPTCqd_hpuJSZMIe1V2XUGhfM0_NTldmnViXceHiRpYWDzTnbp5qV8f3I_MEKARDi3PMzd0QID3cAt9nTt4c96yhA7O_SIFja56Xpgz1ZWctb14xAn5j73vzzJGQunD_JbqJiqmQRK0MrxsUznPNeJZe0ON0RXaYB3yymNbAdwLMJ3QZWECNWwFtemLc0rUUI4uUQwB9yIDRmw8qndhGVH78T9utFpuoBnGkI3vuWl0BEMphkugbzvEBHj4dhH8D3qZSAbIhHroIaE3iigfvsc8CsVgU6v8vbOkl1XkIMA16phuBAhHBnzdwifEQYmlVHul1sH0v8ErXsScTuJqanNp8rc-27Ydd5jYByFWXUS-MTjxGsy5oZcN8YD1YcehI5-AnT2bvTsD6aRPkaYzq9Ge5A_x-HJUfimfhsEBJwuSAKbqZdG7LA0SlI0)
---
There I learned the West Point Honor Code: “A cadet will not lie, cheat, steal, or tolerate those who do.” It’s a code that still guides my life to this day. After graduation, I served for eight years in the United States Army, fighting terrorists from the skies during Operation Iraqi Freedom. **During my service, I logged over 750 combat flight hours and earned a Combat Action Badge and two Air Medals.**
---
[](http://links.jjformichigan.com/u/click?_t=70fde66bc0554ca7a14c16f5ebafdbd9&_m=722bfe0fc1d5437fa65db2a2a0e0eed1&_e=q_0TKsUPTCqd_hpuJSZMIe1V2XUGhfM0_NTldmnViXceHiRpYWDzTnbp5qV8f3I_MEKARDi3PMzd0QID3cAt9nTt4c96yhA7O_SIFja56XoaO69anYl0-81Oq-snOeN3MDMPr5xQ29SFy1qj3xEsoyt2wWcuYhJHdgx9VJFTK4KdtdFmNdVJdDs_pV4Ba7zl6z5LoP-1RYrR4FOF96R4ftqJy5Pdgz1P72vbtpLvXwiVA0mTsuh2HyzB2kUFCMfYG2zD8A8X9I-7fY3ZPXMslSRkCb-BOfxmbDs_Ot5p-tzYisvorTjbDUehE3tzKpOIlQkOwNYJ_4n7Vwnmeh_Y1nGZBY7w-FCEdWVd7KmsS57bft_2VQ20fGsEPvnJj75cUtwrGoREINWYF4A9FcvzftFj--SBkJ5YwIPdlFbiIPymLIkKQXSZqcZk5oBcqLI0)
---
After my military service, I returned to Michigan and helped run our family business, creating local jobs and tripling our growth. The same values I learned in the military guided me as a business owner as we worked to strengthen our community and support local initiatives.

clean_body: | | | Friend, It’s Republican John James, and I wanted to take a moment to share my story with you. It’s a story of the American Dream, Duty, Honor, and Service. My story starts on a street across from Mississippi State. My father lived there growing up but was unable to attend the school because he was Black. My parents grew up in the Jim Crow South, but that didn’t stop them from believing in the promise of America. They moved to Michigan, where my dad started our family business. He believed deeply in the American Dream and instilled in me a strong work ethic and the belief that I should never feel sorry for myself. Through my father’s and mother’s guidance, I learned the values that make America great. They taught me never to believe that I should receive handouts just because of the color of my skin. In America, we can be whoever we want to be. That belief resonated with me more than anything else. I took my father’s teachings to heart. That’s why, at the age of 18, I attended West Point. There I learned the West Point Honor Code: “A cadet will not lie, cheat, steal, or tolerate those who do.” It’s a code that still guides my life to this day. After graduation, I served for eight years in the United States Army, fighting terrorists from the skies during Operation Iraqi Freedom. During my service, I logged over 750 combat flight hours and earned a Combat Action Badge and two Air Medals. After my military service, I returned to Michigan and helped run our family business, creating local jobs and tripling our growth. The same values I learned in the military guided me as a business owner as we worked to strengthen our community and support local initiatives. Next, I continued my duty to serve by stepping up and representing Michigan’s 10th District in Congress. I had the honor of serving as the only Black Republican congressman from Michigan — something my father could never have imagined while growing up in the Jim Crow South. Now I am stepping up once again to serve as Governor of Michigan. Not for my own glory, but in service to Michigan, my wife, and my three children Michigan is at a crossroads. The road to electing a Republican president in 2028 runs right through Michigan. If we want to build a greater Michigan and a greater America, we must elect a Republican governor in Michigan. For our children. For our families. For the future of our country. Thank you for taking the time to read my story. I went deep undercover -- deeper than I've ever gone before. And I did it because the story demanded it. Because the truth was locked behind a door that only someone willing to completely disappear could open.

I traveled state to state with my team. We lived out of hotels. We burned through operational expenses keeping our cover tight. Every detail had to be perfect -- because one slip doesn't just end the investigation. It can end careers. **It can put people in danger**.

This was one of the best performances of my career. And I mean that with full weight.

**The danger was real. The cost was real.**

Hotels. Equipment. Fuel. State-to-state travel. Operational security.

### Fellow Angry Patriots,
This post includes links to all of the interviews I've conducted with candidates running in **[Ohio's 7th Congressional District.](https://substack.com/redirect/6dac6324-92f9-44df-8721-ec6578799fea?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
The format varied. Some candidates chose to do these in person, others did not, and a couple I wanted to do remotely mainly due to audio issues. Every candidate was asked variations of the same questions, which are included in the linked document below. Each candidate also has a dedicated page with short video clips, and under each one I've added a brief, unbiased commentary on my experience with them.
#### [Candidate Questions](https://substack.com/redirect/b1448631-cdb7-4fd6-82b5-0e2e8470ac36?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Two candidates are not included: [Ed FitzGerald](https://substack.com/redirect/3c473eff-38c4-4e8e-9430-9ea0e4d10126?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and [Brian Poindexter.](https://substack.com/redirect/f0fe1005-933a-4e60-a853-7c00c6c9789b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Ed FitzGerald initially reached out to set something up. We tried to connect over a couple of weeks, but he never found the time.
Brian Poindexter and his campaign told me directly they did not have time.
My door is still open to both of them so they can complete the same process as everyone else before the primary.
I'll be direct. It should concern you when a candidate cannot find an hour to talk policy while asking for your vote.
There are a few possible explanations.
**One** , they do not want to be on record discussing these issues. I was told the same thing by consultants during my first campaign. Avoid firm positions, avoid being pinned down on camera.
**Two** , they may not be confident in their positions or comfortable in a long-form setting. It is easier to stick to stump speeches and controlled forums that do not allow for deeper discussion.
**Three** , and this is fair to acknowledge, they may not see value in coming on The Angry Democrat or do not want to associate with the platform. That is a political decision.
But the outcome is the same. There are gaps.
I still welcome both campaigns to reach out and complete the interview before the primary.

## NASA Plans $20 Billion Moon Base
NASA announced Tuesday that it would spend $20 billion over seven years [to build a permanent base](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGO8yAQhJ_G7rDwYkNcUPxNuvztldYCS8IJQwRcrLz9ibzCVbuakWb0zddtv2GIId3_40G6-bwnOmuk1qjsR87JYCVHMbyovE8sFZNDswMHybhgsO4OQ3zvy-i0JwISI-lZqWURYoHL-NAKpUBrgBu7GZJGrcrPAkCR9XBx8xh0T-MC1pnPHNQklOebk9LjCpsQdlg4udBymb5zSO1BPr7zi8pk8zFG_WjtWQfxb4DrANfzPKdkbKfo_gDXagMlS_174ucmrMjMT4iOdTzWORlwZkKMISdWbEKQy2XbxqLd8-xylWpY-P3AED-97U9jvTT8BgAA__-RfX4M) on the moon's surface, pausing previous plans for an orbiting lunar station. The agency will repurpose components from that Lunar Gateway station, already largely built by contractors, to build a surface base instead. The plan will unfold in [three phases](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL2upSAURp9GOwyCfxQU09idaac0G9ge9wTBABfj29-c-wq3_Jova61_r-0F5Cm8_8KJuuxxC3hnj6Vg2s4Yg4GMDj1VTM8NKUNwYDbBxcS4ZGLcHJB_tqF1ekcUKFvU_TwPg5SDWNpDD65HY9S89GZUi1mMdXzql12pZUIE1ZL-vHEpxp73XMydnHeu3DTtMAolpW0Gjo5KTN3_SKEcuPsnVkydjWfr9VHKlRv5pxFrI9b7vrsAGbp3rI1YPzYsoUfI-JmQgX2FiuQzo0CFoFDFzEpkYA_CigxOTGQhswCFYgDP8gUW2RU92acRa5u0u27ynvI0NwN_n0D-B6b8qmDV4jsAAP__cFGIBA), beginning with robotic landers and new technology testing, then semi-habitable infrastructure, and finally long-duration crew quarters. NASA also revealed plans to develop an entirely new spacecraft designed to reach Mars. The aggressive timeline comes as [China pushes toward its own 2030 moon landing](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkEHO2yAQRk-Dd0R4MHayYJGq8u7vplIrdWONYZzQYiYC_li-fUWv0O2M9PS99_Nj-cAQQ3p8w51s3XhJdJRItVJedua0YiFPMbwpnwfmgsnjuoCCUSotwSweQzyXofN2IwLSHdl-moZB6wGu3dPiagxc0azrTQ3eeZrGjWj0N--dMVfqgm00pcH0qlcwXfS0qZsfxw0N3LR2YlDkQ-V8-c0h1Sdt8eQ35YvjvYv2WeurCH0XMAuYj-O47CW1n4CZkvwsAuYmJWCu5J6JIz_OdsOCsrIsL0pegpJriDFwkpxkM5dNXTpMjqLkvIYa0kPGz4RZloo1cBIwY5b3e__rT88_hJ7ZBS_01y8tKB3lO-VXl61_HQ1dxkkM6rFjiP-m1__q_bbwNwAA__-5qJbr), with SpaceX and Blue Origin still working to complete lunar landers under contract.
## FedEx Enters Same-Day Delivery War
FedEx is jumping into [the same-day delivery war](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLFuhDAQRL_GdCB718Bd4SIN3aVNiRa8PhwZ-2SsI_x95CJfkG6kJ73RzNdjfpAPPj4_aWdTXJojn0fgUjjPe0pxoYMtB__mfJ2UD4qWlhkkDK3EFvrZkg_XrBtrHDMwNmzUOGqNqOHWbGa5qxtJcsopfRsV97gOVjlakFE5to031SYReiWVhLHD0cm7HQZHPdwRV6ElW19S7r6Tj2VjF6705tytaW-C2Up5HQI_BEwCpvM8uzUua4UCpqoWMEmsWQuYHFv-aQ_aubV0tX_T2hQ5kw_dVvbQZGNfpw_BH8MotHzuldS28q-L3gZ-AwAA__8Hnnmz), launching a service to rival Amazon and Walmart as major retailers battle over who can get packages to doorsteps fastest. The new [FedEx SameDay Local](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkDFvpDAQhX8NdEZmDPgoXFxDt9deiQY8BkeDvbKdJfz7aDeKlD7t06en773_t_mGnn3Y_uFBprg4BzozUymU5iPGsGAmS-wflK4TU8ZgcZlBwiCkEtDPFj1fc1db44iAVE2m1brrlOrgT70b1KiWboSF-nVQetDaLeMKbTv0YHvZ194826SCvpWtBN0o7eRoh8FhD6NSa9VJsr7E1LxFH8pOjq_4oNSs8ajZ7KXcc6X-VjBVMD31U4xH48jSxxP5EVYwbRwXZEFhY5_3CqYXJ0oU0TlKwmEulMT3ZHH6sgvG97DuIjrxRWc8yOIlOK7IdTL2fnpmnwdddXI70PPLrfzq0IeBzwAAAP__7XuNCg), built with last-mile partner OneRail, will offer shoppers two-hour or end-of-day delivery options directly at checkout. OneRail's platform covers nearly 99% of the country and plugs into retailers' existing store networks without requiring new infrastructure. The move comes a week after [Amazon rolled out one-hour](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLFuwyAYhJ8Gb1j4x8bJwNDFW7p2tH7MT0yFwQISK336yq36BJ1OupM-3d3Hbb6hDz7e33EjXV2aIx0lUK2U5y2laLCQpeCflF8H5oLRoplBgOJCchhmiz685r6x2hEByYZ0N459L2UPl2bV6OxFKSGXQZmhMwZEb9At7mKUFDiaxuuTJiQMnegEjK0cnbhapRwOcJVyYb0g62vK7Wfysa7kwis9KbdL2pqg11r3wuQbg4nBdBxHu0SznCGD6UQzmIRkMHUjgwk3_EqR5xRC4elRecfX9Mhc_srfVO4jD1ipVO6wVF5Wv-8-3vlptWvdQpO13Q8fgi9qZL24b-jDT6X6rx-fGr4DAAD__7Udh1s) and three-hour shipping windows in hundreds of U.S. cities, while Walmart already offers three-hour delivery reaching 95% of U.S. households. FedEx says it's betting on demand: 80% of customers surveyed want same-day shipping, and nearly half say they're more likely to complete a purchase if it's included.
## Survey: America's Perfect Fast-Food Plate
A [new survey of 2,000 adults](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGOhCAYhJ8GOzb4g7gWFNfY7bVXml_4WbmgGOA0vv3Fe4VrJpPM5Mtkvl7TC0MM2_sTVzLVp2mjs0SqlfK0prTNWMhRDAfl68RccHM4TyBAcyE5dJPDEK9JNc54IiDZkGn7XikpFTybxbR-IKsHANd67bHvNIASXee0f1qn5yaYmyYkdK1oBfQP2XsxOK09djBIaZkS5EJN-fGdwlYX8vFKB-WHTWsTzVLrXpj8YDAyGLdrT6XeEYPxBjMYhbz9LTF4KvWKdDfp5OUnH3TxTAdhLBxXysFi4TtlT7Zyj6Vyn5LjNq1zYjA22bj9DDGGonumxHvFEP-W1H_ddxj4DQAA__-trIOs) found that the ideal American fast-food meal pulls from multiple chains: a Burger King burger, a Chick-fil-A chicken sandwich, McDonald's fries and chicken nuggets, and a Dairy Queen milkshake. Regional tastes vary. [In-N-Out](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykzzGO6yAQgOHTQGcLZrBxCorXpMtrt0QkDDErDBEmRr79KnuF7X990v91szcXU8zP_24j00KxmfqeqDWqdisl391OnlI8qJ7d1d1l7-4WBMyDwAEm611Mp1Xcm0AEhJyM1FopRAULX432Ulxwmcgvsw4LaCnwTkCSCHBRikfz0QTCJIUUoEfUQVz8PAc3wQXxwZQgH1up43eJua0U0lkOquOjbDyZtbXXzvAfgyuDa-99jHnIQ3m3T8DgulF-82r8q8eU4j5rpsRzczH9Au1P14eBnwAAAP___49qfw) beats both Burger King and Wendy's for best burger out West, Midwesterners favor Arby's curly fries, and Raising Cane's ranks highly across the Southwest. The average respondent spends about $12 on a fast-food meal but believes it should cost [about a third less](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL2O6yAQhZ_G7rDwQExSUNwmXW67pTWEIWbDTwSjWHn7lfcVtjnNOTqf9H3d1hvGFMvjP2ayHOpaaO-JmKmtudbisJOnFN_UPju2jsWjW0HCIqQScFo9xvRZ9ehtIAJSI9nZGK2V0nAeNzufwwJkFKByDhdAr533FBxgkJrMGO3xJhWcZjlLMJMyQV78sgQ8wUWp-6Al-ci1Td81Ft4opE99U5vuNY_JbsyvPqh_A1wHuO77Pj2Raz7aAa6JsJVYHuJOhakdiw1ZZHxSF7yRcNRZBDyiVi9Ci9SnjXMam_WvPaYU-2IGLR8ZY_pl8p9EvS38BAAA___gtX8E). Americans have stuck with their favorite items for an average of 16 years.

On this day in 1934, golfer Horton Smith, 25, claimed victory by one stroke at the first Augusta National Invitation Tournament, . Smith won again two years later, making him the first two-time Masters winner. This year’s tournament tees off on April 9. NASA just announced plans to build a , committing $20 billion over seven years in the biggest shake-up to America's space program in decades. Do you live in the Golden State or know somebody who does? . Today’s partner, , is one we’re especially excited to share. With temperatures rising across much of the country, it’s starting to feel like summer again. Hot weather has a way of exposing one simple issue: most people aren’t as hydrated as they think. That’s why . | NASA Plans $20 Billion Moon Base NASA announced Tuesday that it would spend $20 billion over seven years on the moon's surface, pausing previous plans for an orbiting lunar station. The agency will repurpose components from that Lunar Gateway station, already largely built by contractors, to build a surface base instead. The plan will unfold in , beginning with robotic landers and new technology testing, then semi-habitable infrastructure, and finally long-duration crew quarters. NASA also revealed plans to develop an entirely new spacecraft designed to reach Mars. The aggressive timeline comes as , with SpaceX and Blue Origin still working to complete lunar landers under contract. FedEx Enters Same-Day Delivery War FedEx is jumping into , launching a service to rival Amazon and Walmart as major retailers battle over who can get packages to doorsteps fastest. # I want to know: Who do you think won the debate?
### Your survey responses helped me know what questions to ask last night. Now I'd like to know: Who won? And how do you think we did as moderators?
| | Mar 25
---|---
Thank you to everyone who participated in our pre-debate survey. Your input was essential in helping me craft debate questions about topics that matter to Mainers. If you missed the debate, we'll be posting the full video on Youtube shortly, but you can watch the full livestream here.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/2a9d332d-9669-48d1-b681-5a9f9e1d21c3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Now I'd like to know people's reactions after seeing all eight candidates square off on the same stage. So please take this post debate survey and let me know your reaction to the debate, whether you changed your mind on any of the candidates, and what we could do to make the next event a better experience for those in the audience or streaming at home.
[Start Survey](https://robinsonreport.substack.com/survey/6583277?token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwiaWF0IjoxNzc0NDM4NjQ2LCJleHAiOjE3NzUzMDI2NDYsImlzcyI6InB1Yi0yMjQ2OTM2Iiwic3ViIjoic3VydmV5In0.22BcZKkJ9lvkgH65HMTpITicpZkiPYqhRnkdpsBHAxs)
All of the responses to the last survey and this survey will be kept anonymous. But after the results are in for this survey, I'll share a subscribers-only post will the results. It's not a scientific poll because of the sample size (and because Robinson Report subscribers are 3x-4x smarter than the average voter), but people will be surprised by the results -- I know I was.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/647a3697-92ba-4e13-aa4d-6db6a125f985?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

name: JB Pritzker
subject: Let me be blunt about New Hampshire:
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Chris Pappas for Senate
body:
[](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/221?c0=em_ms_cp_20260325_1.JeDKul&refcode=em20260325-1&t=1&akid=5750%2E582294%2EmB99tl)
Governor JB Pritzker here.
Let me be blunt: **_Everything we care about is on the line in 2026 — and New Hampshire could decide the outcome._**
We’ve already seen the damage Trump’s second term is inflicting on our country: His ICE agents are once again targeting families in broad daylight -- tearing apart communities, rounding up workers, and instilling fear across entire neighborhoods. He’s gutting environmental protections while utility rates spike, forcing working families to foot the bill so his billionaire donors can cash out.
He has no interest in bipartisanship, decency, or democracy. **And if Democrats don’t take back the Senate this November, there will be nothing stopping him.** That’s why we _must_ win in New Hampshire.
**[Chris Pappas is running in a tied race that could decide Senate control. Chip in $5 now to help him win.](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260325_1.scyREm&refcode=em20260325-1&t=2&akid=5750%2E582294%2EmB99tl)**
Trump and his MAGA allies are laser-focused on New Hampshire. They’ve recruited a big-name candidate, they’re lining up GOP billionaire donors, and they know if they win here, they’ll shut the door on a Democratic Senate majority.
We can’t let that happen.
Chris Pappas is a fighter. He’s taken on Big Pharma, defended reproductive freedom, and delivered for working families in one of the toughest districts in the country.
I want him in the Senate. But we’re all going to have to come together to get him there. He’s running in a true battleground. His race is tied. And the GOP machine, desperate to keep Democrats locked out of power, is ready to bury him in dark money and attack ads.
**[That’s why I’m asking-- urgently -- for your help: Can you chip in $5 to help Chris Pappas win in New Hampshire and give us a fighting chance to stop Trump?](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260325_1.scyREm&refcode=em20260325-1&t=3&akid=5750%2E582294%2EmB99tl)**
**[Donate $5 »](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260325_1.scyREm&amount=5&refcode=em20260325-1&t=22&akid=5750%2E582294%2EmB99tl)**
The damage is real. The stakes are massive. And the time to act is right now.
Thank you for standing with Chris and for standing up to the madness.
JB Pritzker
Governor of Illinois
**New Hampshire is poised to be one of the closest Senate races in the country. Will you chip in today to help Chris stop the Republicans from flipping the Granite State red and expanding their Senate majority?**
**[Donate »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em_ms_cp_footer?refcode=em20260325-1&t=23&refcode2=5750_582294_mB99tl&akid=5750%2E582294%2EmB99tl)**

Peter, here’s something I believe in strongly: Politicians shouldn’t get to draw their own district lines and hand-pick their own voters. **Citizens should get to decide who represents them. ** That’s how democracy is supposed to work. And it’s why Eric Holder and I teamed up to build the National Democratic Redistricting Committee with a mission of fighting for fair maps. The truth is not everyone wants to play by the rules. In the last year, we’ve witnessed Republican-controlled states take the unprecedented step of redrawing their congressional maps in the middle of the decade. They even admitted they’re doing this to gain an unfair advantage in the midterm elections. As Democrats, we can’t just copy the same bad behavior. Nobody wants to see us abandon the rule of law or show zero regard for the truth. If that’s how Democrats fight back, then we lose what we’re fighting for in the first place. **But that doesn’t mean we have to sit on our hands, either.** We can’t pretend this redistricting crisis isn’t happening. That’s why states like California and Virginia have decided to fight back in a way that lets the people decide — putting referendums on the ballot that would temporarily level the playing field by ensuring Republicans can’t gerrymander their way to a House majority in the midterms. California voters overwhelmingly approved that approach last fall. Next month, Virginians have the opportunity to do the same. Right now, volunteers are actively organizing to help get out the vote in this special election — in the first weekend of early voting, our team reached over 350,000 Virginians. Make no mistake: Republicans are desperate to hold onto power and avoid accountability. But this movement was built to stop them. clean_body: This is about preserving our democracy not just for November, but for decades to come. | Peter, here’s something I believe in strongly: Politicians shouldn’t get to draw their own district lines and hand-pick their own voters. Citizens should get to decide who represents them. That’s how democracy is supposed to work. And it’s why Eric Holder and I teamed up to build the National Democratic Redistricting Committee with a mission of fighting for fair maps. The truth is not everyone wants to play by the rules. In the last year, we’ve witnessed Republican-controlled states take the unprecedented step of redrawing their congressional maps in the middle of the decade. They even admitted they’re doing this to gain an unfair advantage in the midterm elections. As Democrats, we can’t just copy the same bad behavior. Nobody wants to see us abandon the rule of law or show zero regard for the truth. If that’s how Democrats fight back, then we lose what we’re fighting for in the first place. But that doesn’t mean we have to sit on our hands, either. We can’t pretend this redistricting crisis isn’t happening. That’s why states like California and Virginia have decided to fight back in a way that lets the people decide — putting referendums on the ballot that would temporarily level the playing field by ensuring Republicans can’t gerrymander their way to a House majority in the midterms. California voters overwhelmingly approved that approach last fall. Next month, Virginians have the opportunity to do the same. Right now, volunteers are actively organizing to help get out the vote in this special election — in the first weekend of early voting, our team reached over 350,000 Virginians. Make no mistake: Republicans are desperate to hold onto power and avoid accountability. But this movement was built to stop them. We might not be able to outspend the powerful interests on the other side, but we can out-organize them, out-work them, and outlast them. name: AMAC Action
subject: We need to reach 1 million patriots calling for term limits
body:
You know it and I know it -- Congress is broken.

| |
---
| |
---
| |
---
[](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zg6tm419neslmrhi805oa25trmdvabt9dknesqb8_rp22sh2s8i6epr1c5imep36cph2bs)
---
| | Dear Fellow Conservative,You know it and I know it -- Congress is broken. Politicians have turned “serving the people” into “serving themselves.” They use their positions to get richer and richer every year, while you and I get left behind.Left-wing radicals like Ilhan Omar, Rashida Tlaib, and Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez work to destroy our country from within. And Washington never fixes anything. **[Today, WE THE PEOPLE have a chance to do something about it when you sign your “Time for Term Limits” petition and submit it in the next 72 hours.](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zfq04q5bdaf0co1qptms22vtt325b97br48cdbi0_rp22sh2s8i6epr1c5imep36cph2bs)** Our Founding Fathers never intended for government service to be a permanent career. George Washington famously served just two terms — then went home.Our Founding Fathers also said our government was made for a “moral and religious people.” And they understood that if that moral compass broke down, Congress could easily steer America in the wrong direction, become a do-nothing body, or make government a gravy train for themselves.That’s why they included a powerful safeguard in our Constitution -- an escape hatch -- enshrined in Article V. If Congress ever became too corrupt to fix itself, Article V. says the states can use this provision in the Constitution to act.34 state legislatures can call a convention, propose term limits -- and Congress can’t do a thing about it. [**Here at AMAC Action, we have led the term limits movement in the past, and we are ready to put our efforts behind the movement once again.**](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zb38d0tl218u83eg22p2dd36g2rff8dq4im4pbio_rp22sh2s8i6epr1c5imep36cph2bs)
---
[ **Time for Term Limits** ](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zkvd001htfd3ra1rk640q6e229c6cl3v5rrj00bo_rp22sh2s8i6epr1c5imep36cph2bs)
---
My friend, can you imagine Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez spending 30 more years in Congress?? We are AMAC Action. “AMAC” stands for Association of Mature American Citizens. And when it comes to standing up for the rights of Americans, “action” is what we’re known for.President Trump has said that AMAC Action is so effective that members of Congress run the other way when they see our delegates coming down the hall. And our **“Time for Term Limits”** Petition Drive certainly has Washington lifers on the run![**Please sign your petition and submit it in the next 72 hours.**](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zmpt1gsm8ffkgem3brdjg3t0qqkkmcihdd6u6sb0_rp22sh2s8i6epr1c5imep36cph2bs)
---
**>>** No more golden pensions for people who work 170 days a year and spend half of that just trying to get reelected.**>>** No more using the power of the office to destroy American values from within.**>>** No more insider deals to get rich.**>>** No more jobs for life with nothing to show for it!
---
Some of these grifters and America-haters have been “working” in Congress over 30, and even 40 years!
---
* **Maxine Waters — 34 years**
* **Chuck Schumer — 44 years**
* **Patty Murray — 33 years**

---
They’ve been in the swamp so long they’ve grown gills. Please – let’s not let them drag America down into the swamp with them. It’s time to use the escape hatch our Founders left for us.34 state legislatures are needed. What will embolden states to act is seeing a massive groundswell of support for term limits from millions of Americans just like you.That’s why AMAC Action is spearheading this massive 50-state Petition Drive and why you got my email today.You’ve proven that you’re a patriot who can be counted on to take action. **[Please sign your “Time for Term Limits” petition and submit it in the next 72 hours with your sacrificial donation of $35, $50 or more to spread this national campaign across America.](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zi6aedbn80qheue7khr9sl85m3mfufno1q4bu1a0_rp22sh2s8i6epr1c5imep36cph2bs)** We need to reach **1 million** patriots with petitions just like yours.And that takes time and money.The Washington lifers are counting on having more power, influence, and resources than the American people.They’re counting on our complacency and despair.But here at AMAC Action we say: Let’s finish the fight our Founders began and restore America’s government to the people.Your $35 gift is enough to send and collect 50 more **“Time for Term Limits”** petitions across email, text, and mail. Your gift of $70 funds 100 more **“Time for Term Limits”** petitions.Singlehandedly, you are an indispensable force-multiplier in this effort. But if you do nothing, nothing changes.
---
* Immigration policy will never get fixed and just stay a meaningless election year talking point.
* America’s spending and debt will continue to grow unchecked. Remember when we had a balanced budget? We can get back there if career politicians do something!
* Social Security will keep getting raided while real policies to protect your benefits sit on the back burner.
* Healthcare costs will do nothing but skyrocket leaving seniors vulnerable.
* America’s children will stay trapped in the leftwing indoctrination centers we call “public schools.”
* Radicals like Ilhan Omar, Corey Booker, and Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez will continue to undermine America’s founding values.
* And the Washington, D.C. fat-cats will just get fatter and lazier.

---
Please join our army of patriots who are fed-up with the Washington lifers who work against our interests while our country sinks. What’s even more frustrating is that President Trump has policies that can save the ship and Washington lifers stand in his way! **[Your signed “Time for Term Limits” petition is critical. And we appreciate your donation whether it’s $35, $50 or anything higher or lower. What’s most important is that you respond in the next 72 hours.](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zh09ivbfjdtcd2aplj8i5u5131pctm2qlu2fri40_rp22sh2s8i6epr1c5imep36cph2bs)** **One million “Time for Term Limits” petitions is a bold goal but we can do it if we all pitch in.** Every dollar helps. Every signature counts. Every day matters.Thank you and may God bless you and these United States.
---
| | With hope and urgency,
---
**Rebecca Weber,_Chairwoman_****AMAC Action**
---
| [](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zscpuo6f81s2mtmaq2qgr6l24t1ot8iic3f9p69o_rp22sh2s8i6epr1c5imep36cph2bs)
---
| | P.S. 80% of the American people and President Trump support term limits! But Congress will never vote to limit itself. That’s why the states -- We the People -- must do it. Our Founding Fathers left us a Constitutional escape hatch in case Congress was sinking the ship. It’s Article V. of the Constitution and it’s time we use it to make term limits law. **[Please sign your “Time for Term Limits” petition and submit it with your emergency gift of $35, $50 or more in the next 72 hours.](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z05oj5i9b75n3ri84obidbm04g3ra0a1lqd5ta88_rp22sh2s8i6epr1c5imep36cph2bs)**

| | Friend,
Your life changes the moment you have a child. A new sense of purpose washes over you. And suddenly, life isn’t about you anymore. **It’s about them. About their future. That’s what sustains me in this fight, day in and day out.**
Every night when I walk through the door, no matter how long the day on the campaign trail has been, everything else fades away the moment I see my wife Makenze and our three little boys, Theodore, Bennett, and Harrison.
**Makenze is the rock of our home. Fearless, full of joy, and the most incredible mother to our sons. Watching her pour love into our family reminds me daily what really matters. **
**And those boys? They light up our world and make our house loud, chaotic, and absolutely perfect. That’s what I want for all of my fellow Americans – strong families, real freedom, a colorblind society built on truth and opportunity.**
The energy I feel when I’m out meeting folks like you on the trail comes straight from knowing we’re fighting for something bigger than any election. **We’re fighting for the next generation.**
**And right now, the latest polls confirm that while I’m still in the lead, things are rapidly tightening as we approach the May 19th primary. If we’re going to still be on top when it matters, we can’t take a single day for granted and simply put, I need your immediate help.**

name: Cooper, Roy
subject: A quick note (with pictures)
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Roy Cooper for North Carolina
body:
I’m ready to bring some North Carolina common sense to the U.S. Senate, but I can’t get there without you.
|
# [](https://act.roycooper.com/go/6532?source=&t=1&akid=779%2E124072%2EbCmHja)
| | | |
---
Peter,

I’ve been on the road for our ‘Make Stuff Cost Less’ tour, talking with folks all over our state about what matters most to them. It made me want to send you a quick note.
Ever since launching this campaign for Senate, I’ve had the privilege of meeting with so many North Carolinians face-to-face – and despite everything going on in our country, I still believe our best days are ahead.
[](https://act.roycooper.com/go/7174?t=7&akid=779%2E124072%2EbCmHja)
I’m in this fight to make life more affordable for working families.
[](https://act.roycooper.com/go/7174?t=8&akid=779%2E124072%2EbCmHja)
I’m in this fight to stand up for our small business owners and our farmers, who are struggling under chaotic, good-for-nothing tariffs. I grew up working on the farm in Nash County, so this is personal to me.
[](https://act.roycooper.com/go/7174?t=9&akid=779%2E124072%2EbCmHja)
And I’m in this fight to build a bright future we can hand off to the next generation.
[](https://act.roycooper.com/go/7174?t=10&akid=779%2E124072%2EbCmHja)
Right now, the politicians in Washington DC aren’t looking out for the folks I’m meeting every day. They’re only looking out for their wealthy donors and special interests. That has to change.
**I’m ready to bring some North Carolina common sense to the U.S. Senate, but I can’t get there without you.[So if it fits in your budget, please chip in $5 today to power our grassroots campaign. We have to win this race to return power to the people.](https://act.roycooper.com/go/7175?t=11&akid=779%2E124072%2EbCmHja)**
| | [CHIP IN](https://act.roycooper.com/go/7174?t=12&akid=779%2E124072%2EbCmHja)
---
Thank you for everything,

Roy
| |
* * *
Democrat Roy Cooper is running for U.S. Senate to help take back the Majority for Democrats. North Carolina is Democrats’ best chance to flip a seat from red to blue — the path to stopping Republicans in Washington starts here.

National Republicans will target North Carolina as a key battleground and invest heavily in defeating us.

Cooper is a former state legislator, Attorney General, and most recently Governor of North Carolina. North Carolina will be the most competitive Senate election of 2026, and Cooper enters the race as the most formidable candidate of either party.

Cooper’s signature achievements include helping to expand Medicaid and helping make NC the top state for business by creating thousands of jobs and growing the clean energy economy.

name: Tabitha Isner
subject: Thank you for an incredible launch — here’s what’s next!
body:
We’re grateful for a strong campaign kickoff and excited to see many of you this week in Huntsville and Montgomery.

| | | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/f74a66d9a23b/im-running-for-alabamas-most-flippable-state-senate-seat-in-15-years-13693524?e=62156fa6a8)

[|

|
---
| | | | | |
# A Strong Start for Our Campaign!
---
|
---
| |

This past Saturday afternoon, we officially launched our campaign for Alabama State Senate District 26 at Montgomery Whitewater, and I am so grateful to everyone who came out to celebrate with us. The event was a meaningful opportunity to bring our community together, share our vision for the district, and build momentum for the road ahead.
I was especially honored to be joined by Benard Simelton of the NAACP, who spoke about the racial gerrymandering of this district and the NAACP’s role in helping get it redrawn; Artegus Felder of the Letter Carriers Union, who highlighted the importance of giving working families and labor unions a stronger voice at the legislative table; and civil rights attorney Mitch McGuire, who spoke about the importance of holding government accountable - including how he supported Tabitha in suing the AL Department of Corrections in 2017 for violating the Open Records Act!
Their remarks were a powerful reminder of what this campaign is about: fair representation, accountable leadership, and making sure everyday Alabamians have a voice in the decisions that shape their lives.
It was energizing to see so many supporters, friends, and neighbors gathered in one place, united by a belief that District 26 deserves leadership rooted in service, opportunity, and real results for Alabama families.
I left Saturday even more encouraged about what we can accomplish together. This campaign is powered by people who care deeply about their communities and are ready to help move Alabama forward.
If you were able to join us, thank you for being part of such a special afternoon. If you could not make it, there are still plenty of ways to be part of Team Tabitha. You can chip in to support the campaign or grab a Team Tabitha shirt below and help us spread the word.
---

# Team Tabitha Joining Bid On Blue
---
|
---
| |

This Friday, we’re excited to head to Huntsville for Bid on Blue, hosted by Persist Alabama. The event brings people together for an evening of cocktails, dinner, and live and silent auctions in support of candidates who are working to move Alabama forward. Bid on Blue begins at 6:00 p.m. on March 27 at the Von Braun Center’s Saturn Ballroom.

I also want to give Persist Alabama a special shoutout for the great work they do. While the organization has deep roots in North Alabama, it is helping build support for progressive, values-driven candidates across our state. Persist Alabama works to invest in candidates at every level of government, and that kind of support matters as we work to create a stronger future for Alabama.
---
|
---
| |
# Tabitha To Speak at No Kings Protest
---
|
---
| |

This Saturday, March 28, I’ll be speaking at No Kings Montgomery about the Power of Community. I would love for you to join us there (or at the No Kings event closest to you) in recognizing that we are not alone in fighting for this country.
The event will take place from 12:00 to 2:00 p.m. on the South Lawn of the State Capitol, with a resource fair from 12:00 to 1:00 p.m. followed by the No Kings program from 1:00 to 2:00 p.m. This is a nonviolent, peaceful protest centered on a simple but powerful truth: power belongs to the people.
I’m honored to be part of this event and to stand with others who believe in democracy, accountability, and making sure government remains responsive to the people it serves!

Through this partnership, Her Bold Move and the College Democrats of America Women’s Caucus will work together to expand volunteer engagement around college campuses, strengthen organizing efforts, and build a nationwide pipeline of future women leaders. The partnership will deploy as many as **50,000 college students from across the country (!!!)** to volunteer and plug into active Her Bold Move campaigns supporting women candidates.

We are thrilled to combine our efforts to ensure these voices are finally heard in the halls of power this cycle and beyond.”_

In honor of Women’s History Month, can you help ensure we have the funding to run this partnership in ALL 50 states by pitching in $20.26 or more TODAY?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/128010161/609972813/-1101279714?refcode=EM_F_260325CDWC_NO_8_G_N_L2&amount=20.26&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAwNy8xLzg4NDk1IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImU5YjEyYWI4LTRlMjgtZjExMS05YTQ4LTAwMGQzYTE0YjY0MCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=XGhBbHwDNA1CLX_1YLcE3dZ-EKSY1h6-F9bbSXFmUFw=)

Allison Liu

Hi, it's Jon Ossoff. I’m the only Democratic Senator up for reelection in a state Trump won. And this U.S. Senate race in Georgia will be the most competitive and most expensive in the nation. So if you’re upset by what's being done to our country right now and you're ready to fight back, please chip in what you can to support my campaign here in Georgia. **Here’s the link to donate:**[**https://act.electjon.com/go/donate**](https://act.electjon.com/go/32?c0=ossoff-em-mar26.B6mAX1&refcode=em260325-1-f&t=2&akid=1933%2E5691347%2Ez2Jw5n) Otherwise, let me remind you why I ran for the Senate — and why this moment is even more urgent. name: Anika Page
subject: Dispatch from the Dome: A Step Forward on Healthcare Reform in Mississippi
body:
| | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/mspolicy/dome-dispatch-12852639?e=5703353baa)
---
| |
---
| Good morning Friend,
After a session filled with difficult setbacks and stalled reforms, this week brought a meaningful — and important — step forward. On March 23, **HB 1622 was signed into law by the Governor** , marking another shift in how Mississippi approaches healthcare regulation. While it is not full repeal of Certificate of Need (CON) laws, it represents real progress — particularly for rural communities that have long struggled with access to care. Here’s what that means.
---
|
### **What HB 1622 Does**
At its core, HB 1622 creates a **Small Community Hospital Pilot Program** , allowing certain hospitals to operate with exemptions from traditional CON requirements. For decades, Mississippi’s CON laws have required healthcare providers to obtain government approval before expanding services, adding facilities, or making certain investments. HB 1622 begins to loosen those restrictions — specifically for smaller and rural hospitals. Under this new law:
* Certain small community hospitals will be **exempt from CON requirements** for services on or near their main campus
* Hospitals in the Delta region — one of the most underserved areas in the state — will receive **additional exemptions**
* Up to eight small hospitals will be allowed to establish **dialysis facilities** , improving access to critical treatment
* Hospitals may also expand services like **geriatric psychiatric care** , which is often limited in rural areas

These changes are targeted, but they matter — especially in parts of Mississippi where access to care is limited or declining.
---
|
### **Why This Matters**
Mississippi faces significant challenges when it comes to healthcare access and outcomes. In many rural areas, residents must travel long distances for specialized care, and hospital closures have left gaps that are difficult to fill. By easing regulatory barriers — even in a limited, pilot format — HB 1622 begins to address those challenges. This bill also takes an important step toward reducing one of the most problematic aspects of the current system: the ability for existing providers to block new competition through appeals. Under HB 1622, if a competitor challenges a CON approval and loses, they may now be required to **cover the legal costs of that challenge**. That change alone could help reduce unnecessary delays and open the door for more timely healthcare expansion.
---
|
### **A Step — Not the Finish Line**
It’s important to be clear: this is not full CON repeal. Mississippi still maintains one of the more restrictive CON systems in the country, and meaningful reform will require continued effort. But HB 1622 — alongside HB 3 earlier this session — shows that movement is happening. Rather than one sweeping change, we are seeing incremental steps:
* Raising thresholds
* Creating exemptions
* Testing reforms in targeted areas

That approach may not be fast, but it is beginning to move the system in the right direction.
---
|
### **Learn More**
If you’d like to take a deeper look at what these reforms mean for Mississippi, we’ve published a new policy paper outlining the impact of both HB 3 and HB 1622.
---
| [Read the full analysis here:](https://mspolicy.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=60d4052c66b6745831ccdf7c8&id=572ee5709c&e=5703353baa "Read the full analysis here:")
---
|
### **Looking Ahead**
Healthcare reform remains one of the most important — and complex — policy challenges facing Mississippi. Expanding access, encouraging competition, and reducing unnecessary barriers will take time, but this week’s development is a reminder that progress is possible. As always, I’ll continue tracking what’s happening at the Capitol and breaking it down in plain language.
---
|
### **Track Legislation in Real Time**
If you’d like to follow along as bills move through the process, you can track key legislation throughout the session using the Mississippi Center for Public Policy’s bill tracker.
---
| [Track Bills at the Capitol](https://mspolicy.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=60d4052c66b6745831ccdf7c8&id=0ec1c4b389&e=5703353baa "Track Bills at the Capitol")
---
| Thanks for following along as the session continues to unfold.
I’ll keep tracking what’s moving at the Capitol and breaking it down here each week.
---
| |
---
Until next time,

Anika Page
Director of Operations

| | Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw

Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. ELIZABETH PANNILL FLETCHER FOR CONGRESS [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP10/1/82676/images/Non-Re-Elect%20Logo.png]
For nearly 40 days, Republicans have refused to fund agencies in the Department of Homeland Security other than ICE and CBP, and hardworking public servants and people across our country are paying the price.
Over the weekend, Senate Republicans quietly acknowledged what many of us have been saying all along: there is a path forward to fund DHS and keep critical services running. But instead of choosing stability, President Trump rejected that approach. Why? Because he wants a political fight.
President Trump is doubling down on dangerous demands—including passing the SAVE Act, a sweeping voter restriction proposal that would force millions of eligible Americans to jump through costly and unnecessary hoops just to cast a ballot. At the same time, his administration is escalating the situation, causing further chaos and delay. He’s ordered ICE agents to be deployed at airports starting Monday. The TSA absences have meant growing, hours-long security delays at some of the nation’s busiest airports—including here in Houston—as staffing shortages worsen. Hundreds of TSA agents have already quit because they can’t sustain going without pay for weeks at a time.
Democrats have been clear and consistent: we should fund the essential agencies that keep Americans safe and our country running—while also addressing serious concerns about how immigration enforcement is carried out. That’s a reasonable, constitutional approach.
But House Republicans have refused to engage. Instead, they’re allowing federal workers to go without pay while treating them as leverage in a political standoff.
The American people deserve better than dysfunction and manufactured crisis after manufactured crisis. We need leadership that prioritizes responsible governance, respects the Constitution, and actually works to solve problems.

# **Mamdani 's "mass engagement" office seeks 14 hires with $1.6M in salaries to bring DSA mobilization model to City Hall**
NYC Mayor Zohran Mamdani's newly created Mayor's Office of Mass Engagement **[will reportedly shell out nearly $2 million in taxpayer cash](https://substack.com/redirect/f4549865-bc2b-447e-b570-257d65f8b73a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** for 14 activist-minded positions with six-figure salaries, tasked with building a volunteer system for local advocacy campaigns through "co-governance." The office will be led by longtime DSA member Tascha Van Auken earning over $250,000, with positions including campaign directors ($140,000-$150,000), deputy directors of co-governance ($150,000), and borough leads ($80,000-$90,000).
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/f4549865-bc2b-447e-b570-257d65f8b73a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Why it matters:** Job descriptions read like "a playbook from the NYC-DSA's ground game that helped elect" Mamdani, with one Democratic strategist quipping "the Soviet politburo called, they want their job announcement back" and another raging the campaign director role should be called "Director of Re-Election Political Get Out of the Vote Using Government Money." The deputy director of co-governance language is "almost identical" to what NYC DSA co-chair Grace Mausser called for in her 2025 manifesto "Building Municipal Socialism in New York," where she wrote "we will bring our experience to city hall."
* **The criticism:** Democratic strategist Ken Frydman said the positions are "duplicative," noting "there are already people overseeing city services throughout the five boroughs: they're called commissioners and deputy commissioners" and questioning "why would a 'campaigns director' be on the city payroll, paid for by taxpayers?" The office has been compared to former Mayor Bill de Blasio's taxpayer-funded PR machine, with the new postings coming as Mamdani calls on Albany to hike taxes on the wealthy over the city's purported $5.4 billion budget gap.

# **New Jersey Democrat Governor attends Ramadan event at mosque led by imam with alleged Hamas ties**
New Jersey Democratic Gov. Mikie Sherrill attended a Ramadan event at the Islamic Center of Passaic County, posting photos on social media wearing a hijab and taking selfies with the mosque's longtime leader, Imam Mohammad Qatanani, a Palestinian-born cleric at the center of a decades-long immigration battle over **[alleged ties to Hamas.](https://substack.com/redirect/2eeaa00e-83b8-4834-b48d-937c9f5ad9b7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** Sherrill wrote "thank you to the Islamic Center of Passaic County for welcoming me" and wished "our Muslim neighbors a safe, joyous, and peaceful Eid al-Fitr."

* **Why it matters:** The federal government moved to remove Qatanani from the U.S. in the mid-2000s, arguing he made misrepresentations on his green card application and raising national security concerns tied to Israeli records of his alleged Hamas ties and claims he failed to disclose a prior Israeli detention. However, an immigration judge ruled in Qatanani's favor in 2008, finding the government's evidence unreliable and giving little weight to Israeli court documents, with the judge also finding the government had not proven Qatanani engaged in terrorist activity.
* **The outcome:** A federal appeals court ultimately blocked his deportation in 2025, ruling immigration officials acted improperly by exceeding their authority when attempting "to undo Qatanani's adjustment to LPR status by using an agency regulation in a manner inconsistent with the procedures set out by Congress." The decision focused on legal process rather than resolving underlying allegations, finding federal authorities failed to follow required procedures after missing deadlines to challenge a key ruling granting permanent residency. It's unclear whether Sherrill was aware of Qatanani's legal history at the time of her visit.

# **" Reacher" star Alan Ritchson won't face charges after bloody neighbor brawl, police cite self-defense**
"Reacher" star Alan Ritchson **[will not face charges after a bloody brawl](https://substack.com/redirect/af6e1b97-c0b5-46af-a710-f1b846986479?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** with neighbor Ronnie Taylor, with Brentwood Police telling TMZ that "Mr. Ritchson's actions were found to be in self-defense" after reviewing "video footage and witness statements." Police said "a potential reckless endangerment charge was considered" against Taylor, but "Mr. Ritchson declined to pursue charges," with the case now closed with the District Attorney's agreement.

The office will be led by longtime DSA member Tascha Van Auken earning over $250,000, with positions including campaign directors ($140,000-$150,000), deputy directors of co-governance ($150,000), and borough leads ($80,000-$90,000). | | ---|---|--- Why it matters: Job descriptions read like "a playbook from the NYC-DSA's ground game that helped elect" Mamdani, with one Democratic strategist quipping "the Soviet politburo called, they want their job announcement back" and another raging the campaign director role should be called "Director of Re-Election Political Get Out of the Vote Using Government Money." The deputy director of co-governance language is "almost identical" to what NYC DSA co-chair Grace Mausser called for in her 2025 manifesto "Building Municipal Socialism in New York," where she wrote "we will bring our experience to city hall." The criticism: Democratic strategist Ken Frydman said the positions are "duplicative," noting "there are already people overseeing city services throughout the five boroughs: they're called commissioners and deputy commissioners" and questioning "why would a 'campaigns director' be on the city payroll, paid for by taxpayers?" The office has been compared to former Mayor Bill de Blasio's taxpayer-funded PR machine, with the new postings coming as Mamdani calls on Albany to hike taxes on the wealthy over the city's purported $5.4 billion budget gap. New Jersey Democrat Governor attends Ramadan event at mosque led by imam with alleged Hamas ties New Jersey Democratic Gov. Mikie Sherrill attended a Ramadan event at the Islamic Center of Passaic County, posting photos on social media wearing a hijab and taking selfies with the mosque's longtime leader, Imam Mohammad Qatanani, a Palestinian-born cleric at the center of a decades-long immigration battle over Sherrill wrote "thank you to the Islamic Center of Passaic County for welcoming me" and wished "our Muslim neighbors a safe, joyous, and peaceful Eid al-Fitr." Why it matters: The federal government moved to remove Qatanani from the U.S. in the mid-2000s, arguing he made misrepresentations on his green card application and raising national security concerns tied to Israeli records of his alleged Hamas ties and claims he failed to disclose a prior Israeli detention. However, an immigration judge ruled in Qatanani's favor in 2008, finding the government's evidence unreliable and giving little weight to Israeli court documents, with the judge also finding the government had not proven Qatanani engaged in terrorist activity. The outcome: A federal appeals court ultimately blocked his deportation in 2025, ruling immigration officials acted improperly by exceeding their authority when attempting "to undo Qatanani's adjustment to LPR status by using an agency regulation in a manner inconsistent with the procedures set out by Congress." The decision focused on legal process rather than resolving underlying allegations, finding federal authorities failed to follow required procedures after missing deadlines to challenge a key ruling granting permanent residency. It's unclear whether Sherrill was aware of Qatanani's legal history at the time of her visit. Police said "a potential reckless endangerment charge was considered" against Taylor, but "Mr. Ritchson declined to pursue charges," with the case now closed with the District Attorney's agreement. What happened: Taylor said he confronted Ritchson over his loud motorcycle because he and his kids had been riding on residential streets, claiming "it escalated quite quickly from there. I did push [Ritchson] because he was coming towards me on his bike." Taylor then got in Ritchson's face as two kids watched, prompting the actor to shove Taylor to the ground, after which Taylor pushed Ritchson off his motorcycle and Ritchson started swinging, punching until Taylor stopped coming after him. The result: The entire interaction was recorded by a body camera Ritchson was wearing, with police determining that because Taylor "clearly instigated the physical fight," Ritchson's subsequent actions were self-defense. clean_body: A lot has changed since 1985 – but EMILYs List is still here to meet the moment. | = NEW: A 3X match for the month of March. Every online gift will be tripled through March 31 — until we reach $500,000 and unlock $1.5M for EMILYs List women. If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue, your donation will go through immediately: | = = = Dear Peter, So much has changed since EMILYs List’s founding in 1985 – including so much that I could never have expected back then. I founded EMILYs List in a time before social media, before misinformation could spread instantly on the internet, and long before Donald Trump became a central figure in our politics. But another thing I didn’t expect to see today? A 3X digital match campaign of this scale – the largest in our organization’s history. From now until the end of March, EMILYs List leaders and longtime supporters will triple-match all grassroots contributions up to $500,000 – unlocking $1.5 million to support women running in tough races in 2026. This match is a rare opportunity to make grassroots support go further when it matters most. = = Over the next week, you’ll also hear directly from members of our board about why this match matters and why they’re invested in meeting this moment. I’m excited for you to hear from them — and grateful they’re lending their voices as we work to unlock the full $1.5 million. I never thought that I’d be living through a political moment like this one — but I’m proud that EMILYs List is here to help fund, train, and elect the women ready to fight back and stand up for our rights. We’re working with battle-tested candidates running for office up and down the ballot — from statehouses to the U.S. House — to take back power in 2026. We’ll be facing a well-funded opposition in tight states and districts where every vote matters. | Dear Peter,
As we begin building out our team for the 2026 election cycle, the Deaton for U.S. Senate campaign is recruiting interns and volunteers from across Massachusetts who want to be part of a competitive statewide campaign.
John is running to defeat Senator Ed Markey, and we have a real opportunity to make this race competitive. But winning a statewide race in Massachusetts requires a strong grassroots organization, and that only happens with people across the Commonwealth stepping up to get involved.
---
| |
---
| We are currently expanding our grassroots operation and looking for people who want to help in a variety of ways. Whether you are a student interested in gaining hands-on campaign experience, someone looking to volunteer your time, or someone willing to help organize supporters in your area, there are several opportunities to participate. Ways to get involved include:
* Campaign Internships working with the political, communications, and operations teams
* Volunteer Opportunities such as door knocking, lawn sign deliveries, and hosting a fundraiser in your community
* District Chairs to help lead volunteer efforts in their region, coordinate door knocking and sign distribution, recruit additional volunteers, and serve as a point of contact between the campaign and supporters in their district

Our goal is to continue building a strong grassroots network across the Commonwealth, and having dedicated volunteers and leaders involved early will be critical as the campaign ramps up.
If you are interested in getting involved, please reach out to me directly. I would be happy to connect and talk through how you can help.
---
| | [Email Amanda to Volunteer!](mailto:apeterson1@johndeatonforsenate.com)
---
| Amanda Peterson Political Director John Deaton for U.S. Senate 508-594-9218
Please include your name, town, and whether you are interested in interning, volunteering, serving as a district chair, or helping organize locally when you reach out.

| | Peter,
---
| | Charlie Kirk lived fast. And he lived loud.

He filled arenas. He lit a fire in the next generation on campus.

He confronted lies and spoke truth with boldness.

And he built a movement and a machine that few ever thought possible.

I saw it up close -- _Charlie moved at a pace most couldn 't keep up with. _

But in the middle of all the noise... he made a quiet decision that changed everything.

_**He started observing the Sabbath. **_

Not as a box to check. Not as a religious performance.

_But as an act of obedience. _

As a way of saying, **_" God, You are enough. And because You are enough, I need not carry the weight of a world that was never mine to hold." _**

Every week -- no matter what -- Charlie stopped.

He turned off the noise. He stepped away from the battlefield.

No email. No media. No work.

He gave his full attention fully to God, his wife Erika, and his children.

It was hard at first -- for someone who carried so much.

But over time, it changed him.

And before he was assassinated, he wrote a book about what he had learned...

Peter, like I mentioned, this isn't a political book.

It's not a culture war manifesto.

It's a call to stop.

To rest. To breathe. To return to God.

**Because Charlie believed America hadn 't just forgotten truth... It had forgotten trust. **

Trust that the world keeps spinning when you step away.

Trust that God is in control.

Trust that rest is not weakness -- it's worship.

**In _Stop, in the Name of God,_ you'll discover: **

🔥 How Charlie reclaimed the Sabbath in a world built on burnout

🔥 What sacred rest gave back to him -- as a father, husband, and believer

🔥 Why he believed this message could spark revival in a restless generation

Charlie wrote this book because he knew what it meant to nearly lose his peace -- and what it felt like to find it again.

That's the heartbeat of his final message.
