clean_body: A growing list of leaders already are. | | | | | Hi Peter, Over the past few weeks, our campaign has been proud to earn support from leaders and organizations who care deeply about the future of Middle Tennessee. Former Congressman Jim Cooper announced his endorsement of Chaz’s campaign for Congress, a powerful vote of confidence from someone who knows what it takes to represent this district with integrity. We’ve also been endorsed by the Plumbers and Pipefitters UA Local 572, representing skilled trades workers who help build and power our communities every day. And the Teamsters Rail Conference — representing rail workers across the country — has joined Team Molder as well. The coalition behind this campaign is growing quickly across TN-5. Jim Cooper is on Team Molder. UA Local 572 is on Team Molder. The Teamsters Rail Conference is on Team Molder. The question is: are you? ~~ | | ~~ Thanks for being part of this growing team. — Team Molder | | ---|---|--- About Chaz Molder Chaz Molder is the Mayor of Columbia, Tennessee, serving since 2019 and re-elected in 2022. A Columbia native and graduate of the University of Tennessee and the University of Memphis Law School, he returned home to build a career in law and public service. body:
|
# [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/128052716/610080739/-343666687?refcode=AU_GWN_CL_GEN_GEN_AC_20260325_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODMxNCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxZDBiZjE4My04MjI4LWYxMTEtOWE0OC0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=7NjzDgqkvtTvcuYYavJuwgcxg98s0ecaAwSr3owLRmY=&emci=7ae7f17d-8228-f111-9a48-000d3a14b640&emdi=1d0bf183-8228-f111-9a48-000d3a14b640&ceid=28008880)
---
Peter, I won’t take office for another 9 months, but I’ve been working hard behind the scenes to ensure we hit the ground running on _Day One._ First order of business? **Strengthening Wake County’s District Attorney’s Office.** Wake County is the largest county in North Carolina, but our DA’s Office hasn’t kept up with our growth. Mecklenburg County — a smaller county than Wake — has _twice_ as many prosecutors as we do. They have 94. We only have 44. That means victims have to wait years rather than months for justice, and repeat offenders stay on the street much longer. If we continue on the current trajectory without additional resources, we're much more likely to have cases fall through the cracks. subject: Newsletter from Rep. Ryan Chamberlin
body:
Newsletter from Rep. Ryan Chamberlin

| | | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/repryanchamberlin/newsletter-from-rep-ryan-chamberlin-kqs1grv7ud-12933037?e=d1c1b9864f)
---
| | | | |
---
| |
# NEWSLETTER FROM REP. RYAN CHAMBERLIN
---
| | Friends and Neighbors,

**Sine Die marks the close of the 2026 Legislative Session,** and I am grateful for the opportunity to serve our district and state these past 60 days. I want to thank my colleagues, staff, and all those who contributed to making this session a success. Together, we worked to advance priorities that strengthen our communities and move Florida forward.
While the regular session has concluded, **we will be returning to Tallahassee for a special session at the end of April** to continue work on key issues, including the state budget and other top priorities.
As always, please do not hesitate to [**contact my office**](https://ryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=fc681111d7&e=d1c1b9864f) if there is something we can do for you. My team and I would be more than happy to help you in any way we can.
---
| |
# Resolution Filed and Published
---
|
---
| | **I am proud to have sponsored**[**House Ceremonial Resolution 8103**](https://ryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=0cfd707897&e=d1c1b9864f)**to designate May 10, 2026, as First Responders Mental Health Awareness Day in Florida.**
Our law enforcement officers, firefighters, EMTs, paramedics, and dispatchers face unimaginable stress and trauma in the line of duty. While they work tirelessly to protect our communities, we must also ensure they have the support, resources, and encouragement they need to care for their own mental health.
This resolution is about breaking the stigma, promoting access to critical services, and sending a clear message: taking care of your mental health is a sign of strength.
**To all of our first responders — thank you for your sacrifice, your courage, and your unwavering commitment to keeping Florida safe.** We stand with you.
---
| |
# Events in the Capitol and District
---
|
---
| | **I enjoyed attending our final Legislative Prayer Breakfast of the session.** We were also honored to have a special guest, 2025 The Voice winner Adam David, who delivered a powerful performance of “Hard Fought Hallelujah.”
What a great way to begin our wrap up of another legislative session.
---
|
---
|
---
| | **Congratulations to VOCAL – Voices of Change Animal League on a fantastic 10th Annual Furball.** It was a great night in support of an incredible nonprofit that continues to make a meaningful difference for animals in our community.
**Raising $809,883 toward their nonprofit and capital campaign** for expansion is an incredible achievement and will help VOCAL continue expanding their reach and impact.
---
|
---
|
---
| | **Congratulations to Empath Health on the ribbon cutting of the Nancy Renyhart Dementia Education Center.** The strong turnout reflects how meaningful this new resource will be for families across our region.
This project was made possible in part through state funding secured by our office alongside Senator McClain, helping transform the facility into a space dedicated to dementia education and support services for caregivers and loved ones.
To learn more about dementia resources and educational opportunities, visit: [**https://hospiceofmarion.org/dementia/**](https://ryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=77f1cf2e39&e=d1c1b9864f)
---
| |
# Recent Meetings in Tallahassee:
---
|
---
| | **It was a privilege to meet with representatives from Pregnancy and Family Resource Alliance and Personhood Florida** to discuss the important work they are doing to support women, children, and families across our state.
From providing critical resources and counseling to advocating for policies that strengthen protections for the unborn, these organizations are on the front lines serving some of the most vulnerable in our communities. Their commitment to life, compassion, and family-centered support makes a meaningful difference every day.
Thank you for taking the time to share your insights and for your continued dedication to Florida’s families. I look forward to continuing the conversation on how we can work together to ensure both mothers and babies have the support they need to thrive.
---
|
---
|
---
| | **I had a productive meeting with Second Harvest Food Bank of Central Florida** to discuss their expansion plans in Marion County and the growing need for food assistance in our community.
Second Harvest plays a critical role in partnering with local nonprofits and community organizations to fight food insecurity, and their plans to expand in Marion County will help reach even more neighbors in need. I appreciate their commitment to serving our region and look forward to supporting efforts that strengthen resources for families across our community.
---
|
---
|
---
| | **It was a pleasure meeting Mary Connolly, a proud Ocala constituent who is making a difference both academically and professionally.**
Mary is currently a student at the University of Central Florida and is serving as a Legislative Intern for Representative Kaylee Tuck. It’s always encouraging to see young leaders from our community stepping up to serve and gaining firsthand experience in the legislative process.
Ocala continues to produce outstanding students who are committed to public service, and Mary is a great example of that bright future. Wishing her continued success as she works toward her goals!
---
|
---
|
---
| | **It was great to see my friend Courtney Ballestero from the Florida Early Childhood Advocacy Fellowship to discuss the importance of investing in early childhood education and care across our state.**
Strong early learning opportunities lay the foundation for lifelong success, and it’s encouraging to see passionate advocates working to strengthen policies that support Florida’s children, families, and educators. Thank you, Courtney, for your dedication to ensuring every child has the opportunity to thrive from the very start. It was great to see my friend Courtney Ballestero from the Florida Early Childhood Advocacy Fellowship to discuss the importance of investing in early childhood education and care across our state.
Strong early learning opportunities lay the foundation for lifelong success, and it’s encouraging to see passionate advocates working to strengthen policies that support Florida’s children, families, and educators. Thank you, Courtney, for your dedication to ensuring every child has the opportunity to thrive from the very start.
---
|
---
|
---
| | **Enjoyed a quick meet and greet with Americans for Prosperity.**
Appreciate the opportunity to connect, exchange ideas, and continue the conversation about policies that support freedom, opportunity, and a strong future for Florida. Looking forward to staying in touch!
---
|
---
|
---
| | **Enjoyed sitting down with the American Conservation Coalition to discuss the future of conservation and responsible environmental stewardship.** We had a thoughtful conversation about protecting Florida’s natural resources while promoting economic growth and innovation.
From expanding clean energy solutions to preserving our waterways and public lands, it’s encouraging to see young leaders engaged and bringing forward-thinking ideas to the table. I appreciate their passion for practical, market-driven approaches that keep Florida beautiful for generations to come.
---
|
---
| |
# Other Key Remarks:
---
|
---
| | **Congrats to our Speaker Danny Perez** on the unveiling of his portrait today, It will hang in this chamber for the next 100 years.
---
|
---
|
---
| | Rep. Yvette Benarroch, Rep. Meg Weinberger, Rep. Sam Greco, Rep. Vanessa Oliver, Rep. Bill Conerly, Rep. Nan Cobb, Rep. Nathan Boyles, Rep. Brian Hodgers
---
| | Meet my colleagues I've shared the 14th floor the past 2 years with at the Capitol. We're looking forward to wrapping up this session and we will all be getting new office assignments come November.
---
|
---
| | | | | | | | | | |
---
| |
---
| | **It was great to have Allison Leibfried serving as a Page this week, during this year’s Legislative Session!**
The House Page Program gives students a unique opportunity to experience the legislative process up close while assisting with the day-to-day operations of the Capitol. Allison did a fantastic job representing our community and stepping up to serve during session.
Thank you, Allison, for your hard work and for taking part in this great program!
---
|
---
| | Thank you for your continued support of my leadership in the Florida House! I look forward to sharing with you again soon.
Best regards,
---
|
---
| | | | | | | | | | | | **Ryan Chamberlin****State Representative****District 24**

The Vice President has been pretty quiet lately.
# [](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/35?t=1&akid=2145%2E791427%2EU-bb20)
Friend, you may have noticed that Vice President JD Vance has been pretty quiet lately.
There’s a simple explanation for his disappearance: JD Vance spent all of 2024 campaigning against needless, endless wars overseas. Now, he’s helping to lead one in Iran. Just look at some of his statements:
[](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/5324?t=2&akid=2145%2E791427%2EU-bb20)
[](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/5325?t=3&akid=2145%2E791427%2EU-bb20)
Here’s JD Vance talking specifically about going to war with Iran in 2024:
[](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/5326?t=4&akid=2145%2E791427%2EU-bb20)
Friend, let’s be painfully clear about this: **JD Vance wants to run for President in 2028.** The truth is that he’s a fraud who has conned American voters, selling them lies about ending forever wars and then turning around and starting yet another destabilizing conflict.
**Now, he is trying to distance himself from Trump’s disastrous, unpopular presidency. We’re not going to let him get away with it.**
Every mistake this White House has made — from kicking millions of Americans off their healthcare plans, to sending people to torture camps in El Salvador, to allowing ICE to get away with murdering two of my constituents in Minneapolis, to waging a deadly and destructive war of aggression in Iran — JD Vance has stood by it.
Friend, the first thing we can do to take power out of the hands of these corrupt, lying criminals in the Trump administration is to absolutely obliterate the GOP in the midterms this November.
If we can take back the majority in Congress, we can investigate their corruption, block funding for their war crimes and ICE terror, and make JD Vance irrelevant.

body:
The top 10% of earners comprise 49.2% of consumer spending. Billionaire Trump donors are getting handed pardons left and right. Wealthy politicians are getting richer by the hour.

| [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/128053718/610084248/-109627149?refcode=BLU_EM_SAN_2026-03-25_1&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85ODI2MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmZmYwZTczNC04NTI4LWYxMTEtOWE0OC0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=wiShfaMjhgV7rDZufopk-Ij6advrzZvJfgsQUau5_FU=)
---
| Peter,

**It feels like we’re all living in two different worlds nowadays.**

The top 10% of earners comprise 49.2% of consumer spending. Billionaire Trump donors are getting handed pardons left and right. Wealthy politicians are getting richer by the hour.

Meanwhile, Trump's tariff inflation is chewing through the wallets of working families. Oil prices are skyrocketing. Medicaid is being slashed to pay for billionaire tax breaks.

For too long, Washington has served the interests of billionaires and billionaire corporations. Corrupt politicians have abandoned the constituents who elected them.

**I’m no ordinary politician.** Born and raised in Orange, California, to a working-class immigrant family, I have spent my life fighting for the working people of this country.

body:
| | | Peter, The Trump administration has spent the past year brutalizing anyone who gets in their way. One of their targets was Leqaa Kordia, a woman who lost 175 family members in Gaza and had the audacity to peacefully protest their deaths. ICE detained her at a routine check-in and locked her in a Texas detention center for over a year without criminal charges or a trial. Their goal was to silence her and intimidate the rest of us. body:
Rep. DeGette refuses to stop sending weapons to Israel. Her primary opponent supports an arms embargo and a Free Palestine.
#
Peter,
Corporate Democrats like Rep. Diana DeGette are the problem.
**Last week, the CO-01 congresswoman was confronted by a constituent about her vote to send more weapons and bombs to Israel – and she doubled down.**
[](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260325-mk.GUuiM4&refcode=em20260325-37601&%3Bamounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&%3Bamount=5&t=2&akid=37601%2E1203867%2ERHwE2p)
Not only did she regurgitate the Israel lobby’s talking points and confusingly claim that Justice Democrat Rep. Delia Ramirez’s Block the Bombs Act is somehow both “too specific” and “too vague”... but she also got aggressive with her constituent and made a point to say: **“If the only issue that you care about is this issue, then you should not vote for me."**
DeGette tried to say she isn’t taking AIPAC money anymore, to which another constituent rightfully asked: _“You’re sending Israel bombs and they aren’t even paying you?”_ That’s not leadership. It’s complicity.
Unlike DeGette, who’s been in office for the last 30 years, Justice Democrats-endorsed primary challenger Melat Kiros has a simple take on this issue: **Free Palestine and pass an arms embargo on ALL weapons to Israel now.**

In solidarity,
Justice Democrats

The Missouri Supreme Court just gave Republicans the green light to move forward with their gerrymandered congressional map - locking in MAGA seats for the next decade and wiping away Democratic representation in the state.
This isn't a minor setback. This is a MAJOR loss in the redistricting war that will determine House control for years to come.
So here's the question: Will Democrats respond? Or will we do what we always do - issue statements, express concern, and let MAGA walk all over us?
Because right now, MAGA is winning this fight. Texas gerrymandered. Florida gerrymandered. North Carolina locked in their maps. And now Missouri just got court approval to rig their districts too.
They're not playing games. They're not playing fair. They're playing to WIN by any means necessary.
And what are Democrats doing? Not enough.
Colorado Draws the Line exists because we're DONE waiting for permission to defend democracy. We're DONE debating strategy while MAGA rigs the game. We're DONE losing because we're too afraid to fight as hard as they do.
Missouri landed a devastating blow. Colorado is the counterpunch.
Our ballot initiative flips 3-4 seats and proves Democrats aren't going to roll over while MAGA gerrymanders their way to one-party rule. We're fighting fire with fire. We're matching their aggression with our own.

Friend, Over the past couple of weeks, one thing has been consistent as we’ve traveled across the state: people are showing up and paying attention.
Seth was in Leominster, Quincy, and Woburn. He was in these towns to meet MA residents and attend caucuses. And on Friday the 13th, a meet-and-greet in Salem filled up with over 100 people. * * *
_**By David Shuster**_
If there is any Trump government run spectacle more absurd than long, shuffling lines of citizens surrendering their belts, phones, and carry-ons to a rubber bin, it is the ignorant and simplistic belief that such a security spectacle can be improved by the addition of ICE agents.
And thus, we have Donald Trump's latest rotting brainstorm: Trump has now deployed ICE agents to airports to somehow shorten the monstrous queues at TSA checkpoints.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/d8bc941d-d18d-45fe-8526-96cd23059c53?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Trump said it was his idea and was as simple and yet important as "the invention of the paper clip." Seriously. He said that.
Trump's "paper clip" is so poorly and ridiculously conceived that one is tempted to admire it as a work of grotesque art. The problem, plainly stated, is a shortage of trained security personnel. The remedy is not to import federal agents whose training lies elsewhere entirely and place them loitering in terminals like decorative office plants.
The mind reels.

| [](https://substack.com/redirect/f7503597-a5d6-4cd9-9be2-57d3e4a4e565?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Airport security is not a matter of posture. It requires specific training, coordination, and experience, things ICE agents, by design, don't have.
Even the largest federal workers' union has warned that using "untrained, armed" personnel in place of TSA officers could actually make things worse.
So what exactly are taxpayers getting here?
At best, a very expensive illusion of action. At worst, a misallocation of federal resources during a crisis created by the Trump administration itself.

Trump refuses to agree with a republican and democratic senate compromise stemming from thorny issues involving ICE masks and warrantless raids. The bipartisan agreement is essentially to punt on the ICE issues (with votes on ICE separately in the weeks ahead) and immediately pass a stand alone bill funding TSA and giving TSA agents the back pay they are owed. Trump, ever the toddler, said "no" and keeps demanding all of DHS be funded at once with no ICE restrictions ever.
So, TSA remains understaffed because TSA workers remain unpaid.

Fewer and fewer TSA agents are showing up to work; lines are getting longer; and travel nightmares include waiting in a TSA security line for longer than 4 hours in Atlanta and Houston. Several other airports have security lines stretching 3 hours. Fun times.
Adding insult to the misery, ICE agents are simply standing around watching the security line madness.

It is the Trump administration bureaucratic equivalent of prescribing a new hat for a person with a broken leg.
There is, however, a remarkable irony lurking beneath the absurdity, and it is too rich to ignore. Thanks to endless examples of ICE agents opening fire with tear gas and real bullets when confronted by anti-ICE activists and citizen observers, ICE has acquired a certain reputation.

| [](https://substack.com/redirect/4a1b4a0d-37f2-4b36-b9b5-0b939405085d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
As the deaths of Alex Pretti and Renee Good in Minneapolis underscored, ICE is associated with the violent, sociopathic, disregard of constitutional rights.
So, maybe having ICE agents stand around idly in airports is the least harmful use of their time. In other words, it is better to have them misdirect a family than shoot an ICE protester in the face.
This is not, of course, a serious defense of the airport deployment. It is merely an acknowledgment that whenever the Trump administration gets confused (most days of the week) its follies begin to compete with one another for the title of "least objectionable." The fact we've been reduced to such a calculation is itself an indictment of the Trump era.

---|---|---
Here is the bottom line. If the goal is to shorten TSA airport lines, the answer is clear: Trump should support and sign the bipartisan compromise, pay TSA workers, restore staffing levels, and treat airport security like the specialized job it is. Anything else, including an ICE deployment, is just theater.
And Trump theater, no matter how dramatic, is not getting anyone through security to their flight faster.

Team, I love to hike. Honestly, it’s like medicine. There’s nothing better than walking out the door and seeing Camelback Mountain or heading out into the Phoenix Mountain Preserve. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/128055282/610089346/497319470?refcode=260325_mgw_hike_img1&ms=260325_mgw_hike&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDYwODgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiYTA1MDI0YjAtODgyOC1mMTExLTlhNDgtMDAwZDNhMTRiNjQwIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=f__1OCXe9t7wyp9ZpR8xMM-w_-19B0955DcykjFRh4w=) It’s one of the things that makes living in Arizona so special. But changing temperatures are making it harder to enjoy the places we love. Across our state, Arizonans are feeling the impacts of climate change—skyrocketing utility bills, more frequent droughts, and an increasing number of wildfires. body:
Cuba Si! Bloquero, No!

| | | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/b1a9239a2065/welcome-to-the-m4f-dispatch-305?e=81ab29c4d2)

[|

| | | | | |
# _Yes to Human Dignity; No to Sanctions!_
---
|
---
| |
**Cuba, Si! Bloquero, No!** We have returned. Representing the Movement for Freedom on the Nuestra America Convoy to Cuba was a profoundly impactful experience. **Our delegation, comprising 160 participants, collaborated with Code Pink, facilitating the delivery of approximately 7,000 pounds of medical supplies from Global Health Partners, alongside individual contributions such as solar panels, over-the-counter vitamins and medications, and household and sanitary supplies.** Specifically, the Movement for Freedom contributed reading glasses of various strengths, which were highly valued by the aging population.
Beyond the material items provided, the spirit of shared humanity and mutual affection expressed by Cubans across all sectors was of paramount importance. In discussions with government officials, hip-hop artists, members of the LGBTQ community, and local citizens at block parties or in front of their homes playing dominoes, the central appeal was consistent: recognize our humanity and allow Cubans to determine the course of their own nation. **Economic sanctions constitute a form of warfare that has failed to benefit the Cuban populace for over sixty years.**
If you are able to attend, members of our delegation will present a report on the convoy and its findings for individuals in the DMV area on [Thursday, March 26, 2026, at 6:00 PM ET, at Busboys and Poets, located at 450 K Street NW, Washington, DC 20001.](https://movement4freedom.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c20cdecc59106d39c65725a01&id=74bf455a2a&e=81ab29c4d2)
In solidarity,Team M4F

---
| |
# _Follow the Money: Distributing Aid in Cuba_
---
| | | | | | | | | | [|
---](https://movement4freedom.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c20cdecc59106d39c65725a01&id=af2f2b0a4f&e=81ab29c4d2)
| | | Brenda Lopez is a representative of [Global Health Partners](https://movement4freedom.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c20cdecc59106d39c65725a01&id=a7b0d4df81&e=81ab29c4d2), which has sent nearly $150 million in medical supplies and aid to Cuba over the past 24 years. [**Hear from her regarding the $450,000 worth of supplies shipped to Cuba for the Nuestra America Convoy and who received the donations.** ](https://movement4freedom.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c20cdecc59106d39c65725a01&id=a803c12df8&e=81ab29c4d2)

| | Primary election season is underway in many states, and these races are one of the most important moments to make your voice heard — especially in local and state contests that directly impact your daily life.
If you’re voting by mail, double-check your state’s deadlines and return requirements now. Make sure your ballot is completed correctly, signed where required, and sent back with enough time to arrive before the cutoff. If you’re voting in person, confirm your polling location, hours, and what identification (if any) you need to bring.
A simple plan makes participation far more likely. Put the date on your calendar. Set reminders. Talk with friends and family about when and how you’ll vote.Democracy works best when we show up — and that starts with being prepared.

| | This week, we’re proud to spotlight Jocelyn Sida, Candidate for Mayor of Fontana, CA.

**She is working to bring people-centered leadership to Fontana, and with the title of “The People’s Mayor”, she is putting her community first above all else.**

Jocelyn (Joz) has stated, “I’m grateful for the support of Movement for Freedom and for their shared commitment to dignity, safety, and justice for all. This campaign is rooted in a simple belief: that families in Fontana deserve to feel safe, that our children deserve to grow up healthy and free from pollution and harm, and that our community deserves a quality of life we can be proud of.”

Her dedication to Fontana is what makes her the ideal Politivist!

subject: Proud to have been endorsed by Planned Parenthood Action Fund
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY BELL FOR MISSOURI
body:
Peter,

I am honored to have earned the endorsement of Planned Parenthood Action Fund—and I'm especially proud to be the **only** candidate in this race with their support.

This isn't just another endorsement.

**It's recognition of who has _actually_ been in the fight and who will keep fighting when it counts most.** Look, I have always believed that everyone deserves the freedom to make their own healthcare decisions without politicians getting in the way.

That shouldn't be controversial. Yet, **Republicans in Washington have gone out of their way to make women's access to basic healthcare a dangerous political bargaining chip.**

When extremists overturned _Roe v. Wade,_ I didn't wait to act. I joined more than 80 prosecutors across the country in making one thing clear: I would not prosecute anyone for seeking or providing an abortion. No one should ever be criminalized for a personal, often lifesaving, healthcare decision.

Some people talk about protecting rights. _Others step up when it actually matters._

And the truth is...we're still in the middle of this fight. In Missouri, the Republican supermajority is working overtime to override the will of the people. Missourians JUST voted to enshrine abortion rights in 2024—and already, anti-abortion extremists are trying to undo it and drag us backward.

I'm going to keep doing everything I can to protect and expand reproductive freedoms alongside Planned Parenthood Action Fund in Missouri and all over the country. But I can't do it alone.

clean_body: Peter, I am honored to have earned the endorsement of Planned Parenthood Action Fund—and I'm especially proud to be the only candidate in this race with their support. Yet, Republicans in Washington have gone out of their way to make women's access to basic healthcare a dangerous political bargaining chip. When extremists overturned Roe v. Wade, I didn't wait to act. I joined more than 80 prosecutors across the country in making one thing clear: I would not prosecute anyone for seeking or providing an abortion. No one should ever be criminalized for a personal, often lifesaving, healthcare decision. Some people talk about protecting rights. Others step up when it actually matters. And the truth is...we're still in the middle of this fight. In Missouri, the Republican supermajority is working overtime to override the will of the people. body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24?refcode=260325 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24?refcode=260325]
I don’t say this lightly, but your right to vote — your right to hold politicians accountable — is under attack.
I know that because I’ve spent my career protecting elections, and it’s why I co-wrote with Rep. Bonamici a new piece sounding the alarm.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24?refcode=260325 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24?refcode=260325]
FIGHT BACK [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24?refcode=260325]
Here’s the truth: Right now, politicians in Washington DC are pushing the so-called SAVE America Act — a bill that would throw voter registration into chaos and block eligible Americans from voting.
Not protect elections — block voters.
The proposal would require people to show costly documents like a passport or birth certificate just to register. That might sound simple — until you realize millions of Americans don’t have easy access to those documents.
Let’s be clear: noncitizen voting is already illegal and extremely rare. Here in Oregon, we reviewed 61 million votes over nearly two decades and found j ust 38 unlawful votes — with zero impact on any election outcome.
So why create new barriers? Because when fewer people vote, some politicians think they have a better shot at winning.
That’s not how democracy is supposed to work. Our system works best when it’s run locally — by election officials who know their communities and follow the law. It works when voting is accessible, secure, and trusted.
That’s what we’ve built in Oregon. And it’s exactly what this bill would undermine.
As Oregon’s Secretary of State, I work to protect free, fair, and secure elections — and to make sure every eligible voter can participate without unnecessary barriers. But I can’t do this alone. So please, if you believe in protecting the freedom to vote — not restricting it — will you chip in today to help us fight back? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24?refcode=260325]
DONATE NOW [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24?refcode=260325]
Thank you,

body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rb-email-26 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rb-email-26]
Do what I say, no matter how extreme, or I’ll pull critical funding from your state.
That's right: Donald Trump is once again trying to weaponize essential federal funding as a political bargaining chip.
This time, he’s holding billions of dollars in USDA funding hostage, harming the millions of families and children who rely on these programs for food assistance.
Trump has tried this strategy again and again, and again and again lost to us in court. It was illegal then and it still is now — so once again, I’m taking this administration to court.
If you support this work, please consider chipping in to my re-election campaign before the end of the quarter by clicking here. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rb-email-26?amount=50]
This is all part of the same losing strategy Trump’s been running since he returned to the White House last year: He’s illegally using congressionally-approved funding to coerce and force states like California to comply with his vague, hateful, and unrelated policies on everything from immigration to so-called gender ideology, and diversity, equity, and inclusion.
Bottom line: The President is using critical funds as leverage for unpopular policies on his extreme, political to-do list.
In this case, the funding we’re talking about covers more than 30 million children who participate in school lunch programs — that’s more than one in three kids in America. In California alone, it covers over $2 billion in child nutrition funding, and billions more for SNAP and WIC services.
All of it is now at risk because of a partisan political checklist.
But Trump doesn't have the legal authority to attach these conditions to this funding.
I’ve repeatedly challenged this administration’s unlawful attempts to impose illegal conditions on unrelated grant funding — and I’ve repeatedly won, too.
So I'm co-leading a coalition of 21 attorneys general in suing the USDA to protect this critical funding and block Trump’s outrageous and illegal conditions.
If you're with me, will you help power our work with a contribution right now? Anything you can give before our end-of-quarter fundraising deadline will have a meaningful impact on what we can accomplish together. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rb-email-26?amount=50]

The Trump administration has made clear it will use every tool it has, including the food on our children’s lunch trays , to force its political agenda on states. I won't allow it.
We've beaten them before. We'll beat them again.
I'll keep you updated.
—Rob

Jason Crow For Colorado [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP21/1/88523/images/Screenshot%202025-08-21%20at%2010.50.41%E2%80%AFAM.png]
Hi there, serving in the United States Army was one of the greatest honors of my life. I’ve never forgotten the creed I lived by when I served as an Army Ranger:

“My country expects me to move further, faster, and fight harder than any other.”
“I will shoulder more than my share of the task, whatever it may be, 100% and then some.”
“Under no circumstances will I ever embarrass my country.”

After 9/11, I served three combat tours in Iraq and Afghanistan.

My three tours taught me a lot about respect, working under pressure, and the value of selfless service to others.

As a leader, it was on me to set an example — to be the last one to eat, and the first one to jump out of the plane.

https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jc-em-mar26?amount=10 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jc-em-mar26?amount=10]In Congress, I work every day to be a true servant leader for my constituents. But the leadership we’re seeing at the very top right now is the exact opposite.

Donald Trump doesn't care about the promises he's made to the American people. He makes it more and more clear every day he’s in the White House.

But I care about the Creed I lived by as an Army Ranger, and I care about the oath I took to our Constitution when I was sworn into Congress.

I joined the military to protect our rights and freedoms. I ran for office to make a difference in people’s lives. We need more leaders who are ready to do the hard work and bring people together.

body:
Necessitous people are not free people.
# [](https://act.sarahmcbride.com/go/1269?t=1&akid=3009%2E21716%2EM7sqo5)
There’s something you should know about me — I’m a self-proclaimed nerd.
The build-the-Capitol-out-of-LEGOs, can’t-resist-a-good-history-fact kind of nerd.
[](https://act.sarahmcbride.com/go/1184?c0=mcb-em-20260325-1.-2Tbuc&refcode=em20260325-3009&t=2&akid=3009%2E21716%2EM7sqo5)
And since I started serving in Congress, I keep coming back to one line from Franklin Roosevelt that I think about all the time:
**Necessitous people are not free people.**
FDR said it while the country was fighting tyranny abroad and living in the shadow of the Great Depression. His point was simple and still relevant today.
When people are hungry, when they can’t find work, when they can’t afford a doctor or a roof over their heads, they don’t feel free. They feel trapped. And that’s when dictators find an opening.
That’s why I focus so much on affordability and making the American dream real again. The only way we defend the American dream is by making sure everyone has a fair shot at building a stable life.
Economic opportunity is the fountain of freedom. And freedom is the foundation for economic opportunity. _They go hand in hand._
**That’s why I’m fighting for universal health care, childcare, paid family and medical leave, and housing as a human right.** Because a country that works only for the wealthy and well-connected is a country that leaves democracy vulnerable.
I’m going to keep fighting for an America where you can afford to live, raise a family, and plan for the future. But I can’t do it alone.
[**If you’re with me, will you pitch in $5 or $10 right now to help me stay in Congress and keep up the fight for the American dream and the American experiment?**](https://act.sarahmcbride.com/go/1184?c0=mcb-em-20260325-1.-2Tbuc&refcode=em20260325-3009&t=3&akid=3009%2E21716%2EM7sqo5)

Thank you,
Sarah McBride

This week is the 16th anniversary of the Affordable Care Act.
Health care is my number one issue for this campaign. 16 years ago, we took a major step toward affordable health care. Right now, we're going backwards.
Nearly 20% of Pennsylvanians dropped their health care coverage this year because it's too expensive.**Our congressman, Dan Meuser, voted to kick 30,000 of his own constituents off their health insurance.**
That is absolutely insane.
It doesn't have to be like this. There are real, practical policy solutions to make health care **more affordable and less complicated** that we could actually pass in Congress next year.
Here are a few of them:
* Reverse the ACA cuts.
* Reverse the Medicaid cuts.
* Cap the amount of your premiums that can go to health insurance executives' salaries.
* Ban prior authorizations so insurance companies can't break their promises about what's covered and delay your care.

There's a bipartisan coalition for this. These changes are possible and they could save thousands of lives - if someone puts in the work to get them done. I'll get to work on day one.
**But I can 't get to Congress without your help. Our end-of-quarter deadline is in five days, and we need a lot of grassroots support to flip this seat.**
**[If you can, will you chip in today to join me in the fight for affordable health care?](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/c8148b03-3918-4032-adc2-1ae537514557?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**

Mar 25 | | | | | | | | | | | | | ---|---|--- This week is the 16th anniversary of the Affordable Care Act. Health care is my number one issue for this campaign. 16 years ago, we took a major step toward affordable health care. Right now, we're going backwards. Nearly 20% of Pennsylvanians dropped their health care coverage this year because it's too expensive.Our congressman, Dan Meuser, voted to kick 30,000 of his own constituents off their health insurance. That is absolutely insane. It doesn't have to be like this. There are real, practical policy solutions to make health care more affordable and less complicated that we could actually pass in Congress next year. Here are a few of them: Reverse the ACA cuts. Reverse the Medicaid cuts. Cap the amount of your premiums that can go to health insurance executives' salaries. Ban prior authorizations so insurance companies can't break their promises about what's covered and delay your care. There's a bipartisan coalition for this. These changes are possible and they could save thousands of lives - if someone puts in the work to get them done. I'll get to work on day one. But I can 't get to Congress without your help. Peter, when I tell you that a race is close, I really mean it.
In December, we helped make **Akbar Ali** the youngest Georgia legislator in state history, and he’s already making waves in Atlanta. And get this: **He won by 153 votes.**
We also helped elect **Molly Cook,** one of the youngest state senators in Texas history. We went HARD for her campaign — and in the end **she won by 62 votes.**
Even when the races don’t go in our favor, we can be proud of the close margins. Earlier this month in North Carolina, **Nida Allam** came within **1%** of defeating an entrenched incumbent backed with millions of dollars from special interests.
The races we’re competing in aren’t easy layups, Peter. Nothing about what we’re trying to accomplish is easy. We are trying to rebuild the Democratic Party — and the establishment doesn’t like that very much.
They spend millions to defeat our young progressive candidates. They attack these young people and claim they aren’t ready to lead. But with support from Leaders We Deserve, these young candidates have the power to fight back.
In fact, Leaders We Deserve is quite often the biggest single contributor to the campaigns we endorse. And that’s only possible because of this grassroots team.

In 2024, Democrats won decisive victories in statewide offices here in North Carolina, including in our race for Governor. We also broke the GOP’s legislative supermajority. **Let’s be very clear about what that means: Our voters rejected the GOP’s plans for our state.** Their culture wars. Their attacks on our democracy and our freedoms. But a couple weeks before I took office, Republicans pushed through a new law designed to hamstring my administration and secure power in the GOP’s hands — a law that threatens the fairness of future elections. This was just one of Republicans’ blatant attempts to undermine the will of the voters. The GOP also spent months trying to steal a Democratic state Supreme Court Justice’s re-election victory by throwing out tens of thousands of legal ballots. When asked if the Capitol was attacked on January 6, one called it “subject to ongoing controversy and debate.” Other nominees refused to say who won the 2020 election, hiding behind the same rehearsed talking points. Seriously? These are the people being handed lifetime seats on the bench? Demand Justice PAC is exposing these sham nominees and rallying public pressure to stop this judicial takeover — but we can't win this fight alone. **The Secret Behind the Curtain: How I Help Clients Transform Their Bodies by Mastering TDEE**

Over the last 30 years, I've helped actors prepare for movie roles, models get ready for shoots, and mothers of the bride who wanted to look and feel their best for the big day.
And I'm going to let you peek behind the curtain.
The "secret" isn't a magic pill, a 3-day juice cleanse, or some mystery powder I sprinkle on their food. It's something called **Total Daily Energy Expenditure** --TDEE for short.
Sounds boring, right? Like something you'd see buried in a nutrition textbook? Well, here's the thing: if you understand it, you can completely transform how your body burns energy and stores fat. And if you _master_ it, you can hit your goals without starving yourself or living on a treadmill.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9oZWFydGxhbmRqb3VybmFsLnN1YnN0YWNrLmNvbS9zdWJzY3JpYmU_.thMSdlA01Qt9R3wrJwq7jZ6DnttSLb8r-B4IA_Umq9s?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=192147692)
* * *
**How I Build the Game Plan**

When I take on a client, I don't just throw a cookie-cutter workout at them. I have them fill out a detailed questionnaire--everything from grocery shopping habits to current exercise level, daily activities, whether they cook at home, if they play any sports, and even if they have a spouse or kids.
Why? Because your lifestyle is the blueprint. If I know your habits, I can predict outcomes and adjust the plan, so you _actually stick to it_.
And TDEE is the foundation. It's made up of four parts: **BMR, TEF, EAT, and NEAT.** Let's break those down--Coach Scott style.
* * *
**1\. BMR - Your "At Rest" Engine**

Your **Basal Metabolic Rate** (BMR) is the number of calories your body burns just to keep you alive--breathing, pumping blood, maintaining body temperature--before you've even rolled out of bed.
We can calculate it with formulas, or you can get it measured in a body composition test. Here's my _secret tip_ : resistance training builds lean muscle mass, and lean muscle mass increases your BMR. That means you're burning more calories **while you sleep**.
Yes, lifting weights is basically hacking your metabolism. And if you increase bone density along the way, you're bulletproofing your body for the long run.
* * *
**2\. TEF - The Food Furnace**

**Thermic Effect of Food** is how many calories your body burns digesting and processing food. Protein takes the most energy to break down, so eating more high-quality protein literally makes your body work harder and burn more.
I also love adding cultured vegetables--fermented foods like sauerkraut and kimchi--which are great for your gut and add an extra metabolic edge.
* * *
**3\. EAT - The Planned Sweat**

**Exercise Activity Thermogenesis** is what most people think of when they hear "burn calories"--your gym workouts, your runs, your cycling classes.
I start all my clients with a baseline of **walking 3 miles a day**. Then I stack on other training throughout the week:
* **LISS** (Low Intensity Steady State cardio)
* **HIIT** (High Intensity Interval Training)
* Resistance training broken into: SAQ (speed, agility, quickness), power, strength, injury-prevention prehab, mobility, and flexibility work.

We maximize **6 days a week** and keep one day for full rest and recovery. That's how you squeeze the most juice out of your EAT.
* * *
**4\. NEAT - The Secret Weapon**

**Non-Exercise Activity Thermogenesis** is my favorite--and the one most people overlook. This is all the movement you do that's _not_ structured exercise: walking to the store, standing while you talk on the phone, doing chores, even fidgeting in your chair.
True story: my mom used to tell me, "Scotty, stop jiggling your leg," and my teachers complained I couldn't sit still. Turns out, that restless energy was burning calories all day long.
Here's how to boost your NEAT without changing your life:
* Park farther away and walk.
* Take the stairs instead of the elevator.
* Vacuum or mop the floors yourself.
* Hand wash your car.
* Stand up every 20 minutes and do 20 bodyweight squats.

Think of it like **compounding interest** --a little bit done consistently adds up in a big way.
* * *
**Bringing It All Together**

When you understand and control all four factors of TDEE, weight loss becomes predictable. And predictable means repeatable.
That's what I've been doing for decades--using this system to transform people's lives. Whether you're an actor, a model, a mom, or just someone tired of spinning their wheels, these principles work.
You can use them today, right now, and start making changes without feeling deprived.
* * *
**Final Word**

I've spent over 30 years building these tools and tricks, and they've worked for clients in every walk of life. If you're ready to work smarter, not just harder, you can get results you didn't think were possible. And I promise--we'll have some laughs along the way. Contact me at fasteatlive.com or 425.892.4999.
Now... stop reading and go take the stairs.

subject: We need all hands on deck

body:
AIPAC is pouring millions into the Democratic primaries to silence progressive candidates.
# [](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/892?refcode=em20260325-6049-footer&t=1&akid=6049%2E420207%2EFh0HFF)
Peter, I’m furious. This is not the news I wanted to share today.
**AIPAC is gearing up to pour millions of dollars into the Democratic primaries to take down progressive candidates — _again_.**
[](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/47393?c0=pj-em-20260325.n75nvp&refcode=em20260325-6049&t=2&akid=6049%2E420207%2EFh0HFF)
They’re targeting progressive leaders who dare to actually do their jobs, and refuse to be bought or intimidated. AIPAC is exploiting campaign finance loopholes to flood the primaries with their millions, doing everything they can to drown out the voices of our people-powered movement.
**That’s why I’m launching an emergency fund to help candidates who are being hit with these attacks.** This fund will help candidates respond, stay competitive in the face of big money, and keep their campaigns on track so they can focus on winning and standing up for their communities.
[**I’ll tell you more, but first, can you pitch in $3 to support our emergency fund to fight back against these attacks?**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/47393?c0=pj-em-20260325.n75nvp&refcode=em20260325-6049&amount=3&t=3&akid=6049%2E420207%2EFh0HFF)
**[Contribute $3](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/47393?c0=pj-em-20260325.n75nvp&amount=3&refcode=em20260325-6049&t=4&akid=6049%2E420207%2EFh0HFF)**
We’ve seen the kind of damage AIPAC can do before. In New York, they spent over $24 million to unseat Jamaal Bowman, turning his race into the most expensive House primary in history. They did the same thing to Cori Bush, they’ve gone after my sister, and targeted me.
**No progressive candidate is safe from their massive warchest and their willingness to weaponize it against our democracy.**
Even more alarming: The billionaire donors fueling AIPAC are the same ones who bankrolled Trump’s return to office. And now they’re trying to meddle in the Democratic primaries.
When that kind of money crashes into a race, it distorts the entire election. It buries people-powered campaigns under an avalanche of attack ads, and forces candidates to spend time defending themselves instead of focusing on what really matters: speaking to the issues that working people face.
**We can’t stand by while AIPAC tries to dictate the primaries. Elections should be decided by voters, Peter, not whoever can write the biggest check.**
Our emergency fund will make sure progressive candidates have the resources to fight back immediately, and protect the integrity of our primaries before big money can tip the scales.
[**If you’re with me, pitch in $3 today so we can send a message to AIPAC loud and clear: Our democracy is not for sale. The people hold the power to pick our leadership,_not them_. **](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/47393?c0=pj-em-20260325.n75nvp&refcode=em20260325-6049&amount=3&t=5&akid=6049%2E420207%2EFh0HFF)

In solidarity,
Pramila Jayapal

They did the same thing to Cori Bush, they’ve gone after my sister, and targeted me. No progressive candidate is safe from their massive warchest and their willingness to weaponize it against our democracy. Even more alarming: The billionaire donors fueling AIPAC are the same ones who bankrolled Trump’s return to office. And now they’re trying to meddle in the Democratic primaries. When that kind of money crashes into a race, it distorts the entire election. It buries people-powered campaigns under an avalanche of attack ads, and forces candidates to spend time defending themselves instead of focusing on what really matters: speaking to the issues that working people face. We can’t stand by while AIPAC tries to dictate the primaries. Elections should be decided by voters, Peter, not whoever can write the biggest check. Our emergency fund will make sure progressive candidates have the resources to fight back immediately, and protect the integrity of our primaries before big money can tip the scales. In solidarity, Pramila Jayapal | | Email us: info@pramilaforcongress.com

| Peter, have you tried applying for an apartment lately? Why does it cost $100 just to _apply_?
### Apartment Hunting Checklist
✅ Application Fee: $50-$150 📈
✅ Security Deposit: $2,000 📈
✅ Amenity Fee: $500 📈
🔲 Rent budget: Not enough 📉

I’m running for U.S. Senate in Minnesota because the Democrats lining up for what they believe will be a political coronation aren’t just a wrong fit for the job — _**they’re completely detached from reality.**_

The frontrunner,**_Lieutenant Governor Peggy Flanagan, is actually radical._** And Rep. Angie Craig—the one desperately trying to catch her on the left—is a political weathervane who flips whichever way the radical winds blow, with zero regard for principle or the people she claims to serve.

_**Here’s the latest jaw-dropping example:**_

_**Just last year, Rep. Angie Craig voted for the Laken Riley Act—a commonsense bill that told ICE to actually deport illegal migrants with criminal records**. _

Fast-forward to today, and she’s now publicly regretting that vote, whining that giving ICE any new tools under this administration was a “mistake.”

Let that sink in.

**A young woman named Laken Riley was brutally murdered by an illegal immigrant. Congress passed a bill named after her to stop exactly that kind of tragedy. Angie Craig voted yes... and now she’s sorry.**

What a pathetic flip-flop. Another Democrat selling out American safety for left-wing applause.

I’ve never met a Navy SEAL—active or retired—who would ever dream of selling out this country. Not once.

| | | | | | FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASEMarch 25, 2026katherine@julialetlow.com
**CASSIDY STONEWALLS TRUMP’S MAHA AGENDA** _Letlow: Senate Must Advance Dr. Casey Means’ Nomination_
**BATON ROUGE, LA** – Congresswoman Julia Letlow is calling on Senator Bill Cassidy to stop [stonewalling](https://julialetlow.us19.list-manage.com/track/click?u=70758973fc60553eda6683b43&id=8a7756e62a&e=95355a072c) Dr. Casey Means’ nomination and move it forward without delay, arguing that Louisiana Republicans deserve a senator who helps advance President Trump’s Make America Healthy Again agenda, not one who stands in its way.
_“President Trump is leading the effort to Make America Healthy Again, and Dr. Casey Means is an important part of that fight,”_**said Congresswoman Julia Letlow.** _“Her nomination has now been sitting in Bill Cassidy’s committee for a month since her hearing, and he has the power to move it forward. Louisiana Republicans deserve a senator who helps advance President Trump’s agenda, not one who keeps slowing it down.”_
Dr. Means’ nomination is central to President Trump’s broader effort to confront chronic disease, promote prevention, improve nutrition, and bring more serious long-term thinking to healthcare policy. But despite the urgency of that mission and repeated calls for action, her nomination remains stalled in the Senate HELP Committee, which Cassidy chairs.
This is a pattern Louisiana Republicans have seen countless times before. President Trump is trying to put America First, and Bill Cassidy is standing in the way.
###

* * *
The Permanent Campaign is brought to you today in partnership with
Conservative Innovation
Issue: 3/25/2026
* * *

Senate Kills War Powers -- Again

For the third time in a month, Senate Republicans [blocked a resolution](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJycUL1uhSAYfRrcNPgJ6B0Yurjdrh3Nd-FTSRAMcKWP39ihD9Dt5OTk_H09lyc678L2iQdpc7nFRrsUysUlDCehodNjoIPSRtkuwEG1fGhBLsEvfWO1sWqAhnQ_jkKM0zCMza5JoYLp0ct1ssMqV85xfL2MNWvfr0aIxunbiQ8gAWCSorOouHzIXgpu1UsaJvj7tFgodyaGTOnC4i5yIcQbxdCZeDRe76WcmQ0fDGYGc621q5h3F7YSA33j4QKlW8pgDlQzgzlTwEIMZiE5SCn-qLbsLtn2Ht5WTO0ZK6XcJsrRv-9IBnOTtD2r895lNTLBtwOd_61S_vHepeEnAAD__0oCgHo) to strip President Trump of authority to wage war on Iran without congressional approval. The vote was 53-47, almost perfectly along party lines. Sen. Rand Paul was again the [lone Republican defector](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyc0D2OwyAUBODT4I4IP_7igmIbd9l2S4vwXmIkDBYQ-_or7xG2G2mkT5r5eSwPH1PM72-_kQtHXLDg0qn1WH3eyQfak8-0UX1TwwUEGC4kB73ktIwDuoBGwkButFYpe5fSDqsLKkBQOIGQ9JxGqV5yfD0lIhgjLE1DdJckJGgAuGt1Q2-EnvSolUDz1IEp8dnRd2q3UHKjevgeD4o5lyuVfAtlG5Jbe98bk18MZgZzX2mNKV0dg3ktG2U6G4O5UfadGMzaThPcDb_m8dNXvpeTauOVWkmfC-ZIL_KdkME8VIf7GVOKzVimxHvz8U8f-j_OOhz8BgAA__8DS3lb), voting with Democrats, while Sen. John Fetterman was the only Democrat to side with the GOP. [The vote came](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyc0D1ywyAQxfHToM4aWL7kgiKNOqdNqVmza5sZBBpBpBw_4xwh3Wver_h_3ZYbppzK8xNXDvFIC1VaOreediwbY-QtY-GV9yc3WkCCu0h9AbuUvKiBQiSnYeCgvDfGT1r74RXIP0hP9gEEdrpPCqVB6RwyW69QqSGFtyQ1WACYrBkJnbRXq6yR5O42CiO_N8LObYy1NN4P7OngVEp9r1rGWNchh1fvWxP6Q8AsYD7Pc3zUn8Ln-7YKmI9EXAXMTl-Vs0ZqUAqGPdB2ppxTc14Y-Vwx5T-w_6PBEeA3AAD__xp2aSI) hours after the Pentagon confirmed it is deploying thousands of troops from the 82nd Airborne to the Middle East -- the latest escalation in a conflict the White House says is nearly over. ★★★
DHS Deal Hits a Wall

A framework to end the 40-day DHS shutdown is [taking fire from both sides](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyckL1uwyAURp8Gb0T48pcMDF28pWtH69rc2EgYEFDn9SvnEbp90nd0hvPznJ8YYkjbNx7k1jPMPvu5U-uhYiqEK5WIiQ6qGzU_gwDDheSg5xTncfBu9UbCQG60Vil7l9IOu4PRKlzuCjxoZfSCcnkJIfRipZcIMAR3mYQEDQB3rW4ejdAPPWolvFn0ypT4LR47tduaU6N6Yg8nhZTytXK6rfkYott7L43JLwYTg6nvtIcYr4_BlOjdIvVOtTGYjlxTSBuvVHLtDCZtHw9jgPu9cU8Y-QvjlYJjwQ8wVOfLO8QYmrFMie3A8HEP_R-pTgd_AQAA__-fkHgA). Senate Republicans formally offered to fund 94% of the department -- covering TSA, FEMA, and the Coast Guard -- while carving out ICE deportation funding for a separate reconciliation bill. Democrats [rejected the offer](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyckD1uxCAUhE-DO1b4mR-7oEjjbtOmtMjjrU2EAQHxXj_a5AbpRjPSfNL3cd_uLsSQ9nd3ksUrbD77rVProbpUyCGV6BKdVHdqfgMBmouJg9pS3MbBW_R6goHsaIyUZp4mMxwWUI0zzA-JZLRaPIgRHojaoJ8W9XBDsK8nMYECgFnJm3daqEWNSgqvPxUyKb6Ld53aDXNqVC_Xw0UhpfxKOd0wn0O0R--lsemNwcpg7QcdIcbXxmA98kmJno3B2ii5TgxWZZZ5lpr_FdzTmbG63nilL8LO91x4QOKl5pKbiwzWoVpfniHG0LRhUuynC7-Iof_D2GXhJwAA__9r-Hsj), demanding ICE reforms Republicans won't give. President Trump threw more cold water on talks, saying he's "pretty much not happy" with any deal. Meanwhile, TSA's acting administrator told Congress on Wednesday that the agency has lost over 480 officers and is experiencing the [highest wait times](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyckDGu5SAMRVdDOp6ICeS9gmKadH_aKSMDToJEIAJ-sv0RMzv43bV8dGzdP1_rF4YY0v4bTzLuDqvPfm1UWyiYLkJHV8REJ5Wdql9BgOZCclBrius4eOO8ljCQGed5mua3lPNwGCsnaa0HO9o3frQWmwKnlaTtY8WGNATTTUKCAoC3ml4etVAfNapJeG2VY5P4vjw2qi-XU6VyYws3hZRyTzm9XD6HaI7WrsrkLwYLg-V5npctFJrF0jrBYLlyDC24ymDpNxksQvasOo_NHTyGm_hBWELaeU68HcQ9pp1K5Xn7P9KZXcHG6_HdfH5SX_ijS4di_PWEGEPVM5vEfmKI_75rPyj0NvA3AAD__w-UhbA) in its history. ★★★
15-Point Iran Plan Emerges

A potential roadmap to end the Iran war surfaced Wednesday as Pakistani officials confirmed they received a [15-point U.S. ceasefire proposal](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyckD2O5CAUhE9jZ1jw-HFvQLCJs950Q-s1PHcjAUZA2zO3H3k0J5isKqj6VPX_vt4xxJCf_zCRdUdY_e7XTq2HirkQOioRMyWqT2p-BQ6GcclArzmuYvTWeSNhJCvmWan5JuU8vqwSmxRCGeeAb8IJbvymNJdyvil8bDgGezVxCRoAblpNHg3Xf7TQinvz0G5Q_F08dmqT23OjemAPB4Wc90vteXJ7GqN99V7aIP8OsAywnOc5bftHpvOKpQGWGA5ilx9g6fWdCtPM4ycr-G7ErpEstIoU2YmV_SBZwupeDNRYrS9niDE0Mw-KPxOG-E3uvzjrsPAVAAD__zlWegQ) touching on sanctions relief, nuclear rollback, missile limits, and Strait of Hormuz shipping access. Pakistan is pushing for an in-person meeting between U.S. and Iranian officials later this week. Israeli PM Netanyahu has reportedly seen the plan and fears Trump may [settle for terms](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyckD2OgzAQhU9jd47M-AdSuNiGLttuiQwzCiPZBmGHXH9FtCfYbqTR9z299_OYHpETl-d3zBSWkyfccGpUGx-x7BQX2lMslOl4UsUJNHiljQI3lTR1EsOC3oCk0PW9tf1gTC_X0Olu8N4OZo6gcZ7p7qFD7Z12s9bGSg6XSRtwADA4e8Potbu7zlmNfnaLsPq1Y2xUb8tWKh1nbHwSl7Jd11Zuy5ZlCmtrexXmS8AoYGwrrZzS9RMwrlumQu8qYIyYuXBtx4cVMLr-PnjvVOKT1F-Sascr7-pqrnC9MHkE3N-cElffC6ufOfLHLts_xjoD_AYAAP__Qxt4lw) that leave Iran's enrichment capabilities intact. Iran's foreign ministry continues to deny that any negotiations are taking place.

Democrat Flips Trump's Backyard

Democrat Emily Gregory [won a Florida special election](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyckLuupDAQRL8GMiMwr5nAwSZkd9MNUdNumJb8kt3AfP5q5hNuVklVHZ1_P-sPsONw_AVPBi9ebbSrUBHOEBIBUnIQyFM-qNhVt3pSba_0uAa3drU1aKde12S6eR6G-dH3c_0ys0Z6TEhdt2O3wY7QPeceCAd4IsJUs_kstb0etdaPcWgsTO34HLtxaO20jVgN7ZksCJUGYyiULxC-iEOInxRDg9HXzrxEUqn6P5VeKr3c993s8R3o_tR8pZcUHQtjqfSygXNR1Bbf6kyFRFnyETNIUbvjpHYXM1tQjg4u7nunCoEoyadPRRWJPnE41JHjGWydjU03O8dlmquhPTyw-1LJL0ReRv8PAAD___GHh_A) Tuesday, flipping a Palm Beach state House district that includes Mar-a-Lago. Trump had endorsed her opponent. The RNC called it a "snapshot of local quirks," not a national verdict.

★★★
Oklahoma Gets a New Senator

Gov. Kevin Stitt [appointed energy executive](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyc0LtuwyAUxvGngc0ROdzCwNDFW7p2tE7g1EblYhnqvH6V9g26fdJf-g3fx325Y8qpru9YyIczLbHFZVAf6cC6EwbaM1YqdKzU4wICzCTkBHqpebny6EM0Ejj5q7VK2ZuUlm_eGB2MVfoTJUZnVHAuSpAPTdFKB4Yn_5KEBA0AN60uEY3QTl-1EtE8dGBKfO8RB_VLaLXTceJIJ6Va22u1egmt8Oy3MfbO5BuDmcE8NtpSzq_GYN5aoUrPzmDuVHEQg1lbZ52VU_vKuLWC01-ZMGOd8Ch9HK2uDGZ--Lg_U86pG8uUWAumX5iPf_x0evgJAAD__0ejdxU) Alan Armstrong to fill the Senate seat vacated by Markwayne Mullin. Armstrong, who chaired pipeline giant Williams Companies, pledged to focus on permitting reform and said he's "stepping off into the abyss."

★★★
Trump Endorses Hern for Oklahoma

With Armstrong [barred from running](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyckL1u7CAQRp8Gd6zw8GNvQXEbd3vblNYYZr1IGCxgneTtI_II6Y400jma7-OxPjDEkPb_eJB1V1h99muj2kLBdBI6OiMmOqjsVP0KAgwXkoNeU1zHwVvnjYSB7DhNSk2zlNPwsiTdLJ8KxfQU93lzRih9N0_SMJqN_DYE201CggaAWaubRyP0XY9aCW827ZgS79Njo3pzOVUqF7ZwUUgpd8rp5vIxRPtq7axM_mOwMFhKjtFhjP3IYOkNBouQnRWDhRKV_ZvTF7l313EsR20lp503PE_yvGVe-suO-PGOMSQeEq-UsBGDZSjWn58hxlDNxJTYDwy_saH9YbzLwk8AAAD__4Hvfpg) for a full term under Oklahoma law, Trump has already endorsed Rep. Kevin Hern for the November race. The June 16 primary filing window opens April 1.

* * *

President Trump Calls For FISA Renewal

President Trump called on Congress to [pass a clean 18 month extension](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyckLGO8yAQhJ8Gd0R4MRAXFH_jLn97pbWBvXglDMgQ5x7_lDzCdSONZj7p-7qtN-TE-fEfd_Lh5DWWuHZqnQ_MlTBQTZhpp-NBLa6gwEqlJZg1p3Ucog_RahjIj85Nk7tq7YbNU9AB53HWbkQkQ6OyiPM43dFFQDsP7N9PSoMBgKuZLhGtMrMZzaSivZsgJvWsETu1Syi50XFi55M45_JOJV9C2Yfkt95rE_qfgEXA0jfaOKV3J2DZyk6ZXk3AgnHnzK0fn62AxVyVMtbKWDKmKPvx3Kv85obSKZD00yk3Llm2Z63l6AKW4fCxvjglbtaJST125A9p6H8Qd3r4DQAA__9J-X38) of Section 702 of the FISA Act. Conservatives sought to amend the law to inlcude a requirement for the FFBI to obtain a warrant if they want to spy on American citizen. The FBI exploited FISA to spy on Trump's campaign in 2016.

body:
Help us reach 2,000,000 signatures to impeach & remove Trump—sign & share today.
#
On Saturday, March 28, we’re taking to the streets at No Kings events across the country to send a clear message: our democracy depends on Congress holding Donald Trump and his allies accountable through immediate impeachment and removal.
But we’re also building something powerful right now.
We’re on a major push to reach 2,000,000 signatures on our impeachment petition—and we need your help to get there.
[**👉 Add your name and share the petition with your friends and family today.**](https://act.leftnet.org/go/22554?source=em20260325-1532&t=1&akid=1532%2E2118727%2E-kPiPE)
From the ballot box to the picket line to the fight for civil rights, generations of Americans have fought to secure fundamental freedom and dignity for all of us. Now, President Trump is trying to rule like a king, ignoring the Constitution and eroding our democracy. He has committed multiple impeachable offenses, launching illegal and unconstitutional military attacks around the world, sending troops into our communities, attacking free speech, and vowing retribution on anyone who dares to oppose him.
**After you sign and share the petition, visit[ImpeachTrumpAgain.org](https://act.leftnet.org/go/22555?t=2&akid=1532%2E2118727%2E-kPiPE) for printable signs and flyers, and join us at an event near you as we respond to this critical moment!** Help us spread the message that Donald Trump and key Trump officials must be immediately impeached and removed from public office!
[](https://act.leftnet.org/go/22554?source=em20260325-1532&t=3&akid=1532%2E2118727%2E-kPiPE)**NO KINGS Nationwide Day of Action**
Saturday, March 28
[**Click here to find an event and printable “Impeach Trump Again” signs and flyers!**](https://act.leftnet.org/go/22556?t=4&akid=1532%2E2118727%2E-kPiPE)
Trump is engaging in precisely the kind of tyrannical oppression for which the Framers designed the remedy of impeachment and removal in the Constitution. We’re coming together in morally grounded, nonviolent direct action, in cities across the country, to remind this president and the world: America does not belong to wannabe kings or those who govern through fear. It belongs to the people.
Join us on March 28 as we fight for our republic and demand the impeachment and removal of this lawless president.
[**Before you go: help us hit 2,000,000 signatures. Add your name and share the petition right now.**](https://act.leftnet.org/go/22554?source=em20260325-1532&t=5&akid=1532%2E2118727%2E-kPiPE)
In solidarity,
Free Speech For People
**Paid for by Free Speech For People**

Missouri got gerrymandered, Peter.

Here’s where the fight goes next: Missouri got gerrymandered, Peter. Then Missourians fought back. Last fall, at the urging of the White House, the Missouri legislature convened to redraw its congressional map for partisan gain. They rammed through this manipulated map — but now voters are challenging this extreme gerrymander. They took their case to the state Supreme Court. And even though the court ruled against the voters in this case, this fight is far from over. Other cases challenging the map are working their way through the courts. And, more than 300,000 people have signed a petition seeking to force a statewide vote in November on the new map. Across Missouri, people are protesting the new, unfair map at public rallies. I wanted to take a moment to introduce myself, Peter.

My name is Kurt Alme, and I am running for U.S. Senate because I believe Montana deserves leadership rooted in service, accountability, and in the conservative values we were raised on.

I am a Montana native. I was born in Great Falls to two public school teachers who taught me from an early age that hard work, education, and giving back _**matter**_.

Growing up, I lived all across the state - Dillon, Victor, Helena, and Miles City - giving me a deep appreciation for our communities and the people who make Montana great.

[](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=3b15d74620464b8e9d5b5666305480bd&_e=OInCmMFiHWFNk_YAGjT6Twfib7SheCsyBuKjrvm9u2D2LRxYvF2JKp9MuDlJlMidWQjOzzHF66o4apPCI98dUC2aYxR2Ny1MVNtV9BXrjpTlfFhTB_-dXnWZaJn1GdRMn9NDQzXM-McIZPMqpYj78xj9dmf-oBEpagItlczFpy67fYLNyBOO0oUm9bQTWYPTBbj0LliH_-5qfN42_tf7R0Wi23ZdEqY3Yi5t5Sy2u4dgFAVNU6xnLa9mX4cApnbMgsQ9BBtN_MbPvxhT6F1pWN9sJ6zScDIaoQqN6HQSitQrT30HIX3brlzuAJQ5Hu1b9H5k2gedpewoAh64QXZfqviNxoF8cOFyJ3QZKFLuj10VrjRGlzE70W1t4aOe3QIYW-C2QuAXTkBFQ2CfHoeN6mOFq3aSx69ZEUJE93y7nAjOQMwv90-wVSmkZHwOeh6eanXiblRcwUdO882QDZawsiRzbjmISWPyMu6pmanoBhwtl8Xh6U7M2OGFedHl7VRs5qgS7W_GPGQs6blDeqTqb9t5GoUIR4yYM03L5zcVgJlw6rPPK6_u3JJ3fzJaKcRpB177HFhvolhAgUu9voR9CcKL-Q38oDQtAb5JD8YY4-XUyPJMnWyKxyLDn2s0jgwTHiiLu8UblWog-otNgcFoVd8blaEHdW6_b8cD2y-x3DU%3D)
I earned a business degree at the University of Colorado and a law degree at Harvard. But I always knew I would come home. _**And I did.**_

I came back to Montana to serve. First as a prosecutor, and then as Montana's U.S. Attorney, I fought fraud, violent crime and drug trafficking. As a Budget Director for Montana, I worked to balance the budget, cut taxes and keep government accountable. I've also helped lead many nonprofit organizations focused on caring for our youth, seniors, sick and mentally ill to strengthen our communities and serve Montana families. I've dedicated my life to service, and I am ready to keep serving our country.

I've spent my career getting the job done - not chasing headlines.

Now, I am running for U.S. Senate because I've seen firsthand the pressure Montana families are feeling - and Washington isn't working the way it should.

clean_body: Leadership rooted in service and accountability; based in Montana values. | I wanted to take a moment to introduce myself, Peter. My name is Kurt Alme, and I am running for U.S. Senate because I believe Montana deserves leadership rooted in service, accountability, and in the conservative values we were raised on. I am a Montana native. I was born in Great Falls to two public school teachers who taught me from an early age that hard work, education, and giving back matter. Growing up, I lived all across the state - Dillon, Victor, Helena, and Miles City - giving me a deep appreciation for our communities and the people who make Montana great. I earned a business degree at the University of Colorado and a law degree at Harvard. But I always knew I would come home. And I did. I came back to Montana to serve. First as a prosecutor, and then as Montana's U.S. Attorney, I fought fraud, violent crime and drug trafficking. As a Budget Director for Montana, I worked to balance the budget, cut taxes and keep government accountable. I've also helped lead many nonprofit organizations focused on caring for our youth, seniors, sick and mentally ill to strengthen our communities and serve Montana families. I've dedicated my life to service, and I am ready to keep serving our country. I've spent my career getting the job done - not chasing headlines. Now, I am running for U.S. Senate because I've seen firsthand the pressure Montana families are feeling - and Washington isn't working the way it should. I am not running for notoriety or to be part of the DC Swamp. I am running to represent the people I grew up with. I am running for people just like you. But, Peter, I cannot do this alone. This campaign will be built the right way. It will be built with grassroots support from people who believe in our conservative values and believe in defending our Montana way of life. Here's what I am asking: Every single patriot who steps up before midnight tonight is part of the kick-off momentum we need to run a successful campaign. Your support helps us reach voters and prove that this campaign belongs to Montanans - not outside money. Join our team today! Thank you, Kurt Alme FOLLOW KURT ALME ON SOCIAL MEDIA | | Paid for by Alme for Senate Don't want to receive any more of our emails? We hate to see you go: .

clean_body: - Michele Tafoya here! I never really considered running for office. Ever. I was too focused on raising my family, and being the best football sideline reporter I could be. But even in the last few weeks, Minnesota has become the embodiment of everything wrong with politics today. Tim Walz, his inner circle, and the corrupt political class are too busy: Wasting billions of our tax dollars on fraudulent daycares Failing to condemn the activists storming churches Raising prices on hardworking families Sabotaging anything the President wants to do Forcing men into women's spaces Pitting Americans against each other I can 't sit on the sidelines anymore. That's why I'm throwing my hat in the ring and announcing my candidacy for U.S. Senate! thought long and hard about the dynamics of this race before jumping in. Minnesota has long been considered simply out of reach for Republicans. The last time it voted for a GOP President was Nixon. The pundits and political experts say a Republican could never win here. But this year is going to be different for three key reasons: FIRST - I'm running against Tim Walz's right hand. All the rampant fraud that took place here happened under Peggy Flanagan's nose as much as it did under his. We will remind voters about that fact every single day. SECOND - The President has increased his voter share each time he has run. He nearly flipped this state in the last election, and Kamala Harris' running mate was our sitting Governor! Momentum is on our side. THIRD - I'm a different kind of candidate, and I know how to win. I didn't reach the top of my industry by pulling my punches. I put in the work. I never backed down. **" Long lines at Texas airports continue as ICE agents assist strained TSA"** [Spectrum News's](https://substack.com/redirect/461683f7-3fcc-4e9c-873b-b60f8c92f540?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) **None** - Houston -- U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) agents have been deployed to 14 airports across the United States as federal officials look to ease staffing shortages among Transportation Security Administration (TSA) workers during the ongoing partial government shutdown.

**Houston** remains the only Texas city where ICE agents are currently assisting at airports, with personnel spotted at both William P. Hobby Airport and George Bush Intercontinental Airport.

Despite the presence of ICE agents, wait times at Bush Airport were over four hours as of Tuesday morning, according to the airport's website. Meanwhile, Hobby Airport saw wait times under 10 minutes.

More than 100 ICE agents have been sent to major travel hubs, including New York, Atlanta and Chicago, according to federal officials.

At Dallas-Fort Worth International Airport, however, ICE agents have not yet been deployed. Despite the absence of additional personnel, operations at one of the nation's busiest airports have remained steady.

(_[Spectrum News](https://substack.com/redirect/aaf7e6ef-0b38-4836-8b09-4b242471d2c0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)_)

[BECOME A PAID SUBSCRIBER: $70/yr](https://substack.com/redirect/5287978e-832b-48e5-959e-d232935df631?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
**" ICE agents spotted at Bush Airport and reported to be at Hobby"** via [KHOU](https://substack.com/redirect/d706b2e8-2227-4190-b3ba-817a7961755d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) -- Federal immigration officers were seen at a handful of U.S. airports on Monday after President**Donald Trump** said he'd deploy them to supplement the Transportation Security Administration during a government shutdown that has caused long lines at security checkpoints across the country.

That includes both major Houston airports.

KHOU 11's **Julissa Garza** was at Bush Airport Monday morning, where she spotted ICE agents. Bush had security wait times that were more than two hours long and stretched outside the doors at Terminal C. Meanwhile, CNN reported that Hobby Airport also has ICE agents present.

What airports are ICE agents going to?

A spokeswoman for the Department of Homeland Security says "hundreds" of officers will be deployed, but where they're going isn't being disclosed for what the government says are security reasons.

In New Orleans, WWL Louisiana reporter **Mike McDaniel** saw a group of ICE agents at the airport as well.

(_[KHOU](https://substack.com/redirect/b9224ad2-eba8-47ee-b44d-18eb83b53a54?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)_)

**" Corpus Christi council votes to begin process to remove mayor"** [The Texas Tribune's](https://substack.com/redirect/1848c63d-2828-4ea6-af3b-b84d9737b9af?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) **Colleen DeGuzman** - Corpus Christi City Council voted on Tuesday to launch a removal hearing for **Paulette Guajardo** over allegations of misconduct.

The decision comes as the city faces a growing water crisis. A water emergency may be just months away, according to city leaders. But the controversy surrounding the mayor stems from a hotel development project, not the city's management of its water supply.

After a tense debate, council members voted 5-3 to begin a trial to decide whether to eject Guajardo, who has been in office since 2021.

A citizen petition to remove Guajardo that precipitated the council vote includes allegations that she put an item on the council's agenda to award $2 million in tax incentives to a developer seeking to build a Homewood Suites in Corpus Christi, and that a PowerPoint presentation about the project included a slide showing a FEMA flood map that had been altered. (_[TX TRIB](https://substack.com/redirect/a334aa9b-4155-4e37-be03-dab58cb48585?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)_)

**" Dead gardens, dusty cars: Frustrated Corpus Christi residents take precautions as water crisis nears"** [The Texas Tribune's](https://substack.com/redirect/3bf2ab64-0e74-4188-b29c-45450bb07297?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) **Colleen DeGuzman** - Not too long ago, **Tamala Alejandro** said her backyard was lush with a vegetable garden. On the ground, she had watermelons, cantaloupes and potatoes. She loved her herb garden, and her prized possession was her beloved peach tree.

But then, she learned about the looming water emergency in Corpus Christi: the city is edging towards a historic shortage. A yearslong drought and a recent boom of refineries settling along Corpus Christi Bay has nearly drained the city's water supply. Two of the city's three main reservoirs have shrunk below 10% capacity. Now the city is depending on a patchwork of temporary sources for water, which may run dry by July.

Residents have been asked by the city to conserve water, with nonessential, outdoor watering prohibited. The city plans to limit how many days splash pads are open over summer break. A local high school canceled its annual car wash fundraiser.
(_[TX TRIB](https://substack.com/redirect/3bf2ab64-0e74-4188-b29c-45450bb07297?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)_)

**" Fire out and shelter-in-place order is lifted after oil refinery explosion near Texas coast"** via [Dallas Morning News](https://substack.com/redirect/4b256a96-40de-4f20-ad3e-c6b1d38187f0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) - An oil refinery fire near the Texas coast was put out Tuesday and a shelter-in-place order was lifted following air-quality testing, hours after a large explosion at the complex shot plumes of smoke into the air, officials said.

Many donors have already maxed out what they can give for this four-year cycle, ahead of an election where **Gina Ortiz Jones** will be on the ballot, and three of her biggest council rivals, **Sukh Kaur** (D1), **Marina Alderete Gavito** (D7) and **Marc Whyte** (D10), are all term-limited from seeking a full four years in their existing roles.
